Reservation: As this is a voluntary, non-salaried position and not a government job recruitment, no reservation roster is applied to the posts; however, adequate representation will be given to all sections of society as per the scheme, and the panel will be valid for one year.

Educational Qualification

  • Minimum educational qualification: Matric (10th pass).
  • Preference to candidates actively engaged in social service, legal awareness, community activities, SHGs, NGOs, etc.
  • Advocates are not eligible to apply for PLV positions.
  • Previously selected Para Legal Volunteers may also apply again.

Roles and Responsibilities of Para Legal Volunteers

  • To create legal awareness in their area and work as a bridge between victims in need of legal aid and the District Legal Services Authority.
  • To assist in legal aid work at the DLSA office and Legal Aid Centres as and when directed.
  • To participate actively in legal awareness camps and outreach programmes organized by DLSA.
  • To perform any other legal services work assigned by the District Legal Services Authority under NALSA PLV Scheme.

Honorarium & Allowances

Daily Honorarium Rs. 750/- per day under NALSA PLV Scheme (PLV) for those specific days on which DLSA assigns special work or when the PLV brings a person from the village for legal aid / ADR centre or actively participates in legal awareness camps.
Other Allowances No additional allowance of any kind is payable apart from the above honorarium.
Nature of Service Voluntary service only; this is not a regular government post and does not confer any right to government employment.

Selection Process

The advertisement mainly lays down eligibility, instructions and application procedure; selection of PLVs will be done by District Legal Services Authority, Samastipur as per NALSA PLV Scheme guidelines.

  • Scrutiny of applications submitted in prescribed format along with required documents.
  • Preparation of shortlist/panel on the basis of eligibility, local residence, social service interest and other criteria fixed by DLSA.
  • Issue of interview call letter (interview letter format is enclosed in the notification) to shortlisted candidates.
  • Interview and interaction at DLSA Samastipur for final selection.
  • Preparation of final panel of PLVs; panel period will be valid for one year.

How to Apply for Samastipur DLSA Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026

  1. Download or obtain the prescribed application form for Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) as annexed with the advertisement.
  2. Fill the application form completely in Hindi/English, providing all required personal, educational and contact details.
  3. Attach self-attested copies of educational certificates (Matric), other qualification/experience certificates, and a clear photocopy of Aadhaar card.
  4. Attach a declaration/affidavit stating that no criminal or civil case is pending against you and you have not been convicted by any court.
  5. Affix a self-attested passport size photograph at the designated place on the application form.
  6. Place the application form and enclosures in an envelope, write your complete address on a self-addressed envelope with adequate registered postage stamps for correspondence.
  7. Send the application by Registered Post/Speed Post/Ordinary Post or submit by hand to the office of the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Samastipur, so that it reaches on or before 09 March 2026 up to 5:30 PM.
  8. Applications received after the last date or found incomplete/incorrect are liable to be rejected without any information.
  9. Mention your mobile/WhatsApp number clearly in the application form for communication regarding interview, etc.

Important Instructions

  • The applicant must be an Indian citizen and a resident of Samastipur district.
  • The applicant should be physically and mentally healthy, of good character and interested in social service.
  • No candidate should have been convicted by any court, and no criminal or civil case should be pending against them; a declaration/affidavit to this effect must be attached.
  • Applications received after 09 March 2026 (5:30 PM) will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Any deficiency/error in the application form may lead to rejection of the application without notice.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly visit the Samastipur district website ecourt.gov.in/samastipur to get updated information related to this advertisement, interview dates and other notices.
  • This is a voluntary, non-salaried engagement; it does not give any right to regular employment in any government department.

Vacancy Details

Position Number of vacancies
Research Associate III (RA III) 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification: Ph.D. in Physics or equivalent degree with minimum 75% marks or 7.5 CGPA during Ph.D. (graduate) and above 6.0 CGPA (or equivalent percentage of 60%) during M.Sc./B.E/B.Tech./M.E/M.Tech. coursework. Relaxation: 7.0 CGPA or 70% for OBC/EWS, 6.5 CGPA or 65% for SC/ST/PWD.
  • Desired Experience: Good knowledge of more than one of the following topics at the M.Sc. Physics and PhD level: Atomic, Molecular and Optical Physics, Electronics, Quantum Mechanics, Quantum Optics, Electromagnetic Theory, Atomic and laser spectroscopy, Finite Element Modelling and Simulation using COMSOL/ANSYS, Knowledge of ORCAD/EAGLE, Hands on experimental exposure in AMOP (Atomic, Molecular, and Optical Physics) experiments at the PhD level.
  • Ph.D. in Physics. Candidates who have submitted/ defended their Ph.D. thesis and are waiting for final degree can also apply.
  • Must have worked for at least one year at the RAI/RAIII level.
  • Experience in programming with any one of the following: Python/MATLAB/ Mathematica / VHDL/ Verilog/ LabVIEW/ SolidWorks / COMSOL/ ANSYS/ digital & analog electronics/ optics/ fabrication will be useful.
  • Prior demonstrated experience of working in experimental optics and/or experimental atomic and molecular physics.
  • Prior demonstrated experience with precision laser spectroscopy/ laser cooling/ ion trapping/ atom trapping and related areas.
  • Prior demonstrated experience with modelling of light-matter interaction in warm atomic vapor/cold atom/ion trap systems.
  • Demonstrated theoretical ability to model and simulate physics of cold atom/warm vapor quantum memories/repeaters/ etc.
  • Having at-least one original research paper in SCI and or a peer-reviewed journal. Preference shall be given to candidates with more than one publication in a SCI indexed journal.
  • Must be willing to work efficiently in a team environment with other students, research and project staff and postdoctoral fellows, self-motivated, and work under a variety of challenging research conditions.
  • Must have good oral and written communication skills evident through peer-reviewed publications and presentation of work in national/international conferences/workshops/school/meetings/etc.
  • Experience with supervision of PhD/Masters students
  • Exceptional candidates with a very strong publication record having only a theoretical background in light-matter interaction in warm atomic vapor/cold atom/ion trap systems and/or physics of cold atom/warm vapor quantum memories/repeaters/etc. will be considered for this opening subject to fulfilling of the criteria. Such candidates will need to provide an additional letter of recommendation/reference from their previous academic supervisors who may comment on the candidate’s academic and research potential as well as their intellectual output and abilities.
  • Must demonstrate highest work ethics, commitment and dedication to the project.

Salary/ Stipend

  • INR 67000/- + HRA as applicable (9% for Tirupati city)

Age Limit

  • Not more than 36 years

Important Dates

Notification Date 20 February 2026
Application Last date 6 March 2026

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting based on CV, SOP, motivation letter, research proposal and the LORs received.
  • Online interview of the shortlisted candidates.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for the shortlisted/selected candidates.
  • Candidate needs to join duty within 7 days of intimation of selection by the committee.

General Information/ Instructions

  • Research and development
  • Design and development of laser spectroscopy set-up
  • Data recording and documentation of the research work
  • Critical analysis of the experimental results
  • Assist in any other associated experiment
  • Offline on campus physical presence is needed
  • Remote work not possible
  • Supervision and mentoring of research students and interns
  • Attending meetings, workshops, conferences
  • Reporting of experimental data, observations and outcomes in the nature of peer-reviewed manuscripts
  • Teaching responsibilities and supervision of undergraduate and postgraduate students
  • The selected candidate will get opportunity to work on interdisciplinary areas those are required for setting up of the experiment. Some of these are (but not limited to) simulation; designing, fabrication, testing of indigenous instruments in the field of lasers & optics, developing low-noise analog & digital electronics, developing FPGA based systems, ultra-high vacuum, mechanical & software development, neutral atom trapping and so on. Apart from the development of the experiment, they will have to work on simulation and modeling of physics problems that are necessary to meet the experimental goals using open source and/or proprietary software. Developing a complete experiment involves multiple work-packages and developing those requires expertise in interdisciplinary fields. Within a lab, this can be achieved by working in collaborative manner.
  • The work shall involve laser cooling techniques applied to neutral rubidium (Rb) atoms. It will also involve precision laser spectroscopy, experimental quantum optics and applications of quantum information processing protocols. The final objective is to develop a cold atom quantum memory node for quantum repeater applications.
  • Any other requirement/ Supporting material required: 1. Self-attested academic certificates and transcripts from undergraduate level to postgraduate level. 2. A copy of the current CV, a copy of the Statement of purpose (SOP) and motivation letter. 3. A brief research proposal on cold atom quantum memory. 4. Two letters of recommendation required one of which must be from your thesis supervisor (PhD research guide). 5. In case of exceptional candidates as mentioned above, three letters of recommendation are required one of which must be from your thesis supervisor (PhD research guide).
  • The shortlisted candidates will be informed by email only. Selection will be based on the qualification, experience, and interview. No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates appearing for an interview online or offline. The interview date will be notified to the shortlisted candidates by Email. For any queries send mail to [email protected]
  • IIT Tirupati also reserves the right to discontinue the position with 1 month notice if the performance is not satisfactory.

How to Apply

  • Please mark a copy of the application to [email protected].

In this article, you’ll find the NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Institute National Institute of Technology (NIT) Silchar, Assam
Status Institute of National Importance
Department Physics
Position Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
Number of Posts 1 (One)
Research Project Title Quantum Dots integrated titania with plenty of heterojunctions and its utility for green hydrogen production: Beyond Proof of Concept
Funding Agency CSIR (Council of Scientific and Industrial Research)
Project Sanction Number 80/0099/24/EMR-II
Principal Investigator Dr. Ranjith G. Nair, Associate Professor
Contract Duration 3 Years
Fellowship ₹37,000/month
Application Deadline 05-03-2026
Interview Mode Online/Offline (to be decided by the Institute)
Advertisement Number NITS/Dean(R&C)/Physic/705/01/2026

  • IAF Agniveer New Recruitment 2026

  • MCL 677 Various Vacancies Online Form 2026
  • MMRDA 235 AE, JE and More Posts Online Form 2026

About the Research Project

The research project focuses on "Quantum Dots integrated titania with plenty of heterojunctions and its utility for green hydrogen production: Beyond Proof of Concept". This cutting-edge project aims to develop advanced nanomaterials and photocatalytic systems for sustainable hydrogen production, which is crucial for clean energy solutions. The selected JRF will be involved in synthesis, characterization, and testing of quantum dots and titania-based heterojunctions for photocatalytic applications.

Job Description

  • Synthesis of Quantum Dots and Titania nanomaterials
  • Development of metal oxide heterojunctions
  • Fabrication of photocatalytic reactors
  • Testing and evaluation for green hydrogen generation
  • Literature review and data analysis
  • Technical report writing and publication support
  • Laboratory maintenance and safety compliance

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational Qualification: Any one of the following:
    • B.S. (4-year programme) with 55% marks minimum
    • B. Pharmacy (B. Pharm) with 55% marks minimum
    • MBBS with 55% marks minimum
    • Integrated BS-MS programme with 55% marks minimum
    • M.Sc. with 55% marks minimum
    • Bachelor of Engineering (BE) with 55% marks minimum
    • B.Tech. or equivalent degree with 55% marks minimum
  • Competitive Examinations: Must have passed either NET (National Eligibility Test) OR GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering)
  • Percentage Criteria: Minimum 55% marks in the qualifying examination (45% for SC/ST/PwD candidates)

Desirable Qualifications

  • M.Sc. Physics with specialization in relevant field
  • Experience in Nanomaterials Synthesis and Characterization
  • Knowledge of photocatalytic techniques
  • Laboratory experience in material science
  • Published research papers or conference presentations

Age Limit

  • Maximum Age Limit: 28 years as on the date of application (05-03-2026)
  • Age Relaxation: Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for candidates belonging to:
    • SC (Scheduled Caste)
    • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
    • OBC (Other Backward Class)
    • WOMEN candidates
    • PwD (Person with Disability) candidates
  • Calculation: Age will be calculated as on 05-03-2026 (Application deadline date)

Fellowship & Remuneration

  • Monthly Fellowship: ₹37,000/month
  • Nature of Remuneration: Fixed monthly fellowship on contractual basis
  • Duration: 3 years (subject to satisfactory performance)
  • Basis: CSIR norms for JRF fellowship

How to Apply

  1. Download the prescribed application form from the official notification PDF or NIT Silchar website
  2. Fill the application form legibly with all required information
  3. Prepare a comprehensive CV highlighting academic achievements and research interests
  4. Gather all required supporting documents (certificates, marksheets, exam scores, etc.)
  5. Scan all documents clearly (application form, CV, and documents)
  6. Prepare an email with the subject line: "Application for the post of JRF under CSIR project"
  7. Attach all scanned documents to the email
  8. Send the email to the Principal Investigator: [email protected]
  9. Application submission deadline: 05-03-2026

Required Documents

  • Duly filled application form (prescribed format)
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) - comprehensive and detailed
  • Educational certificates and marksheets from Class X onwards
  • NET/GATE Admit Card and Scorecard/Certificate (mandatory)
  • Bachelor's degree certificate and official transcripts
  • Master's degree certificate and official transcripts (if applicable)
  • Character certificate from college/institution principal
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates (if applicable)
  • Disability certificate for PwD candidates (if applicable)
  • Proof of age (Birth certificate or School leaving certificate)
  • Copy of national-level ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Passport)
  • Research papers or publications (if any)

Selection Process

  1. Application Screening: All applications will be reviewed against eligibility criteria
  2. Shortlisting: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on academic performance and NET/GATE scores
  3. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview (mode to be communicated)
  4. Interview Focus: Subject knowledge, research interest, aptitude for research
  5. Final Selection: Based on interview performance and overall merit
  6. Agreement Signing: Selected candidates must sign the JRF agreement at the time of joining

Important Terms & Conditions

  • Employment Type: Temporary, contractual, time-bound project position
  • Duration: 3 years (May be extended based on project progress and performance)
  • Reporting: To the Principal Investigator (Dr. Ranjith G. Nair), Department of Physics
  • No Objection Certificate: Employed candidates must submit NOC from their employer at the time of interview
  • Institute Rights: The Institute reserves the right to:
    • Restrict the number of candidates called for interview based on screening
    • Not recruit if suitable candidates are not found
    • Modify project duration based on funding or progress
  • Agreement Binding: Selected candidates must sign a JRF agreement before joining
  • Compliance: Must adhere to all NIT Silchar rules, regulations, and CSIR guidelines

Important Instructions

  • Ensure all information in the application form is accurate and true
  • Double-check that copies of all certificates are scanned clearly and legibly
  • Keep NET/GATE scorecard ready as it is mandatory documentation
  • Email subject line must be exact: "Application for the post of JRF under CSIR project"
  • Do not miss the application deadline - no late applications will be accepted
  • Use official email only ([email protected])
  • Interview date and mode will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates
  • Attend interview on specified date and time (important for selection)
  • The Institute decision is final and binding

  • Matriculation certificate is the ONLY acceptable proof of age

  • Note: EBC, EWS, and OBC are three DIFFERENT categories. EBC eligible for fee concession only (NOT job reservation)

Indicative Notice in Employment News 27.12.2025

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email

  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

Indian Air Force (IAF)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Offline through the official IAF website. The last date to submit the application form is 04-03-2026. In this article, you’ll find the IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

Indian Air Force Agniveervayu Non-Combatant 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Recruiting Organization Indian Air Force (IAF), Ministry of Defence, Government of India
Recruitment Scheme Agnipath Scheme - Agniveervayu Programme
Intake Number 02/2026
Position Type Agniveervayu Non-Combatant (Supporting roles across various branches)
Service Duration 4 years (Contract-based service)
Service Terms Unmarried male candidates only
Age Group 17-23 years (Born between 02 July 2005 and 02 January 2009)
Educational Qualification Matriculation (10th Pass) or Equivalent
Application Deadline 04-03-2026
Official Website https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in/AV/
Trending Govt Jobs
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • IAF Agniveer New Recruitment 2026
  • DSSSB 911 AE, JE & More Online Form 2026
  • MCL 677 Various Vacancies Online Form 2026
  • MMRDA 235 AE, JE and More Posts Online Form 2026

About Agnipath Scheme

The Agnipath Scheme is a visionary and transformative initiative by the Government of India to strengthen the Armed Forces through recruitment of young talent. The scheme provides an opportunity for Indian youth to serve the nation for a defined period, gain professional experience, develop leadership qualities, and acquire valuable skills. Agniveers (personnel recruited under this scheme) will undergo comprehensive training and skill development during their service period. Upon completion of 4 years of service, outstanding performers may be eligible for permanent enrollment in the regular cadre based on merit and organizational requirements.

Eligibility Criteria

Age Limit

  • Date of Birth Range: Candidates born between 02 July 2005 and 02 January 2009 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply
  • Age at Time of Enrollment: If selected through all stages, the upper age limit at the time of actual enrollment should not exceed 21 years
  • Age Calculation: Age will be calculated as on the date of registration

Marital Status (Very Important)

  • Must be Unmarried: Only unmarried male candidates are eligible for recruitment as Agniveervayu Non-Combatant
  • Marriage Undertaking: Selected candidates must sign a voluntary undertaking that they will NOT marry during the 4-year engagement period
  • Breach of Undertaking: Any Agniveervayu Non-Combatant who marries during the engagement period will be immediately discharged from service without any benefits
  • Regular Cadre Eligibility: Only unmarried Agniveervayu Non-Combatant will be considered for selection in regular cadre as Non-Combatant(E) after 4 years

Educational Qualification

  • Minimum Qualification: Passed Matriculation (10th Standard) or equivalent examination
  • Recognized Board: Must be from education boards recognized by Central, State, or Union Territory as on the date of registration
  • Proof Required: Original matriculation certificate or mark sheet mandatory

Nationality & Residency

  • Must be an Indian citizen
  • Must be a permanent resident of India

Physical & Medical Standards

Physical Requirements

Parameter Requirement
Minimum Height 152 cm (centimeters)
Chest Expansion Minimum 5 cm
Weight Proportionate to height and age

Medical Standards

Vision Standards

  • Refractive Error: Not exceeding ± 3.5 D (diopters) including astigmatism
  • Visual Acuity: 6/36 each eye, correctable to 6/9 each eye
  • Color Vision: CP-III standard
  • Note: Corneal surgery (PRK/LASIK) is NOT acceptable

Hearing Standards

  • Candidate must have normal hearing capability
  • Able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters with each ear separately

Dental Standards

  • Healthy gums and good set of teeth
  • Minimum 14 dental points required
  • Dental implants and implant-supported prosthesis will NOT be awarded any points
  • Candidates wearing fixed or removable orthodontic appliances will be declared UNFIT

General Health Standards

  • Must be fit for the Indian Air Force according to all medical standards
  • Normal body anatomy without loss of any appendages
  • Free from any active or latent, acute or chronic medical or surgical disability
  • No communicable diseases, infections, or skin ailments
  • Physically and mentally FIT to perform duty in any climate, terrain, and region worldwide

General Disqualifications

Narcotic Drugs & Substance Abuse (ZERO TOLERANCE)

  • Consumption of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) banned under NDPS Act 1985 is a rejection criterion
  • Agniveers found in possession, storing, distributing, or consuming such drugs after enrollment shall be liable for disciplinary action including dismissal
  • IAF follows ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY to alcoholism and substance abuse

Body Tattoos

  • Permanent body tattoos are generally NOT permitted
  • Exceptions: Tattoos only on inner forearm (inside elbow to wrist), back of hand, and tribal tattoos as per custom may be considered
  • Final decision on acceptability rests with the Selection Centre
  • Candidates with tattoos must submit two photographs (close-up and distant view) with details during selection test

Gender-Related Disqualifications

  • Candidates found to have predominant characteristics of opposite gender will be rejected as UNFIT
  • Any candidate having undergone gender reassignment surgery will be declared UNFIT

Selection Process

  1. Offline Application: Submit application through official portal https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in/AV/
  2. Initial Screening: Applications will be reviewed for eligibility criteria compliance
  3. Phase I - Written Test: Common entrance examination for basic knowledge
  4. Phase II - Physical Fitness Test (PFT): 1.6 km run, push-ups, sit-ups, and other physical tests
  5. Phase III - Medical Examination: Complete medical examination as per IAF medical standards
  6. Phase IV - Medical Review Board: Final medical fitness decision
  7. Documentation & Verification: Document verification and background check
  8. Final Merit List: Selection based on overall performance and merit

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official IAF Agnipath portal: https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in/AV/
  2. Navigate to "Agniveervayu Non-Combatant" section
  3. Click on "Application Form" sub-tab
  4. Download blank application form and detailed instructions
  5. Read the Information Brochure thoroughly
  6. Fill the application form completely with accurate information
  7. Upload required documents as per instructions
  8. Submit the application Offline 
  9. Note the application reference number for future correspondence
  10. Keep checking the official website for updates regarding selection stages

Documents Required for Application

  • Photograph: Recent passport-size color photograph
  • Educational Certificate: Matriculation/10th pass certificate or equivalent
  • Date of Birth Proof: Birth certificate or school leaving certificate
  • Identification Proof: Aadhaar, Voter ID, or PAN card (any one)
  • Address Proof: Utility bills, rental agreement, or official document
  • Character Certificate: From school/college principal or local authorities
  • Medical Fitness Declaration: As per format provided
  • Caste/Category Certificate: If applicable (for SC/ST/OBC candidates)

Service Terms & Conditions

  • Contract Period: 4 years from date of enrollment
  • Employment Status: Contract-based, not permanent
  • Marital Status Condition: Must not marry during service period; discharge if marriage takes place
  • Training Phase: Comprehensive military training and skill development programs
  • Uniform & Discipline: Subject to military rules, regulations, and Standing Orders
  • Post-Service Options: Exceptional performers (approximately 25% annually) eligible for permanent enrollment as Non-Combatant(E) in regular cadre
  • Exit Benefits: Gratuity, terminal benefits, and other benefits as per government norms at the end of 4 years
  • Severance Pay: In case of medical discharge or other authorized reasons during service

Agniveer Benefits & Career Progression

During Service (4 Years)

  • Monthly stipend/salary as per government norms
  • Accommodation and meals provided
  • Medical and dental care (comprehensive)
  • Life insurance coverage
  • Professional training and skill development
  • Leadership and personality development programs
  • Uniform and necessary equipment
  • Leave benefits as per service rules

Post-Service Career

  • Permanent Cadre Option: Top 25% performers annually eligible for permanent selection as Non-Combatant(E) with service of 17 more years (total 21 years)
  • Civilian Skills: Training imparted during service makes Agniveers valuable in civilian job market
  • Preference in Government Jobs: Agniveers may get preference/weightage in some government sector recruitment
  • Entrepreneurship Support: Government schemes may support Agni veer entrepreneurs
  • Higher Education: Opportunity to pursue education in civilian field after service

Important Instructions & Cautions

  • Fair & Transparent Selection: Selection in IAF is strictly on MERIT and FAIR criteria. NO BRIBE or payments required at any stage
  • Beware of Fraud: Do NOT fall prey to unscrupulous agents claiming to be recruiting agents. All recruitment is through official channels only
  • Official Website Only: Use only official website https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in/AV/ for applications
  • No Backdoor Entry: No personal contacts, references, or influence will help in selection
  • Verify Information: Cross-verify all information from official notifications and brochure
  • Truthfulness: All information provided must be accurate; false information will lead to disqualification and possible legal action

  • 1st Year: ₹30,000/- per month (In Hand: ₹21,000/- + Contribution to Corpus Fund: ₹9,000/-)
  • 2nd Year: ₹33,000/- per month (In Hand: ₹23,100/- + Contribution to Corpus Fund: ₹9,900/-)
  • 3rd Year: ₹36,500/- per month (In Hand: ₹25,550/- + Contribution to Corpus Fund: ₹10,950/-)
  • 4th Year: ₹40,000/- per month (In Hand: ₹28,000/- + Contribution to Corpus Fund: ₹12,000/-)
  • Additional Benefits: Risk and Hardship allowances (as applicable), Dress and Travel allowances, Ration, Clothing, Accommodation and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per existing rules.
  • Seva Nidhi Package: Approximately ₹10.04 Lakhs after four years (₹5.02 lakh candidate contribution + ₹5.02 lakh Government contribution, excluding interest).
  • Insurance Cover: Non-contributory Life Insurance cover of ₹48 Lakhs for the duration of engagement period.
  • Note: No entitlement to gratuity and any kind of pensionary benefits. No contribution to Provident Fund required.

Age Limit (as on Date of Birth Block)

  • Minimum Age: Born on or after 01 January 2006
  • Maximum Age: Born on or before 01 July 2009 (both dates inclusive)
  • Upper Age Limit on Enrolment: Should not exceed 21 years on date of enrolment
  • Note: In case a candidate clears all stages of the Selection Procedure, the upper age limit as on date of enrolment should be 21 years.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: ₹550/- plus 18% GST (Total: ₹649/-) - Non-refundable
  • Payment Mode: Online via Payment Gateway through Net Banking, Debit Cards, Credit Cards, UPI
  • Appeal Medical Board Fee: ₹40/- (if required) - To be deposited in Government Treasury/RBI/SBI through Electronic Military Receivable Order (e-MRO)/Military Receivable Order (MRO)
  • Refund Policy: Application fee and other charges once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and neither the same be held reserved for any other recruitment or selection process.
  • Multiple Payments: If multiple payments are received from a candidate against single application, the excess amount will be refunded back to the originating account after closing of registration.

Important Dates

Event Date/Time
Reopen Online Registration Start Date 03 March 2026 at 1100 Hr
Reopen Online Registration End Date 10 March 2026 at 2300 Hr
Phase-I Online Exam Date 30 March 2026 / 31 March 2026
Admit Card for Phase-I 48-72 hours prior to examination
Provisional Select List Display 14 November 2026
Enrolment List Publication 01 December 2026
Validity of Provisional Select List Six months from date of display (Only for Intake 01/2027)

Selection Process

  • Phase-I - Online Test: Objective type test (bilingual - English & Hindi except English paper)
    • Science Subjects: 60 minutes - Physics, Mathematics and English as per 10+2 CBSE syllabus
    • Other than Science Subjects: 45 minutes - English and Reasoning & General Awareness (RAGA)
    • Both (Science & Other than Science): 85 minutes - Physics, Mathematics, English and RAGA
    • Marking Pattern: +1 mark for correct answer, 0 for unattempted, -0.25 for wrong answer
  • Normalisation of Marks: Marks will be normalised to account for variation in difficulty levels across different sessions
  • Phase-II Testing at ASC: State-wise shortlisted candidates will be called for:
    • Document Verification
    • Physical Fitness Test (PFT-I & PFT-II)
    • Adaptability Test-I (Objective type written test)
    • Adaptability Test-II (As per policy in vogue)
  • Physical Fitness Test Details:
    • PFT-I: 1.6 Km run (Male: within 7 minutes, Female: within 8 minutes)
    • PFT-II for Male: 10 Push-ups (1 min), 10 Sit-ups (1 min), 20 Squats (1 min)
    • PFT-II for Female: 10 Sit-ups (1 min 30 sec), 15 Squats (1 min)
  • Phase-III - Medical Examination: Conducted by Air Force Medical Team as per IAF medical standards including baseline investigations (Blood tests, Urine tests, X-Ray, ECG, USG for females, etc.)
  • Appeal Medical Board: Available for candidates declared medically unfit (Fee: ₹40/-)
  • Final Selection: Based on state-wise merit, medical fitness, availability of vacancies, and meeting all eligibility criteria

General Information/Instructions

  • Marital Status: Only unmarried candidates (male & female) are eligible. Candidates shall undertake not to marry during the four-year engagement period. Marriage during service will result in discharge.
  • Pregnancy Policy: Female candidates shall undertake not to get pregnant during engagement period. Pregnancy will result in discharge and debar from Regular Cadre selection.
  • Medical Standards:
    • Height: Minimum 152 cms for male and female (relaxation for North East/hilly regions/Lakshadweep)
    • Weight: Proportionate to height and age
    • Chest: Male - minimum 77 cms with 5 cms expansion; Female - minimum 5 cms expansion
    • Vision: 6/12 each eye correctable to 6/6, Colour Vision: CP-II
    • Hearing: Normal - able to hear forced whisper from 6 meters
    • Dental: Minimum 14 dental points with healthy gums
    • No history of LASIK/PRK surgery
  • Body Tattoo: Permanent body tattoos not permitted except on inner forearms, back of hand/palm, and tribal tattoos as per custom. Offensive tattoos prohibited.
  • NDPS Policy: Zero tolerance to consumption of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances. Consumption is a reject criterion.
  • Domicile Categories: Permanent Domicile, COAFP-I (Children of Serving Air Force Personnel), COAFP-II (Children of Retired/Discharged/Deceased Air Force Personnel)
  • Engagement Period: Four years under Air Force Act 1950
  • Regular Cadre Opportunity: Up to 25% of each batch may be enrolled in regular cadre based on performance and organisational requirements
  • Leave Entitlement: 30 days annual leave per year plus sick leave as per medical advice
  • Medical & CSD Facilities: Available at Service Hospitals during engagement period
  • No ESM Status: Agniveervayu will not be eligible for Ex-Servicemen status after completion of four years
  • NDA/AFCAT Attempts: Permitted to appear (maximum three attempts) during engagement period subject to conditions
  • Identification Requirements: AADHAAR Card mandatory (exemption for J&K, Ladakh, Assam, Meghalaya candidates)
  • Examination Centres: Candidates to indicate five choices but CASB reserves right to allot any centre
  • No TA/DA: No travel allowance or daily allowance admissible for any stage of selection
  • Mobile Phones Prohibited: Mobile phones/smart watches/electronic devices prohibited in testing areas. Possession will result in permanent debarment.
  • Malpractices: Candidates found indulging in malpractices/unfair means shall be debarred permanently
  • Disclaimer: IAF reserves the right to cancel entire selection process at any stage without assigning any reasons

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: ONLY Online applications accepted
  • Website: https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in
  • Registration Process:
    • Step-I: Register with personal details and contact details. User-ID will be email ID and password will be sent via email/SMS
    • Step-II: Re-login to complete personal details, communication details, qualification details, declaration and upload documents
    • Enter OTPs sent to mobile and email for verification

    • Candidate's signature image (80-150 KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) - black ink on white paper
    • Parent's/Guardian's signature (if below 18 years)
    • Left thumb impression image (50-100 KB in .jpg/.jpeg format)
    • Live image capture via web camera during registration
  • Payment: Pay examination fee of ₹550 + 18% GST via Payment Gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI)
  • Print Application: Take printout of submitted application form and retain for future reference
  • Important Notes:

    • Data entered during registration will be final - no changes permitted later
    • Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn
    • Candidates advised to register at earliest as no extension will be accommodated

Eligibility Criteria for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

1. Educational Qualification

  • Performance Analyst (Physiotherapy): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Physiotherapy from any recognized University/Institution; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Physiotherapy.
  • Performance Analyst (Physiology): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Medical Physiology / Human Physiology / Sports and Exercise Physiology / Biological Sciences; with specified equivalence for B.Sc. (CBZ) and Physiology; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Physiology.
  • Performance Analyst (Anthropometry): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Anthropology or Human Biology; desirable 1 year experience in Anthropometry in sports science.
  • Performance Analyst (Psychology): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Psychology / Clinical Psychology / Applied Psychology / Sports Psychology; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Psychology.
  • Performance Analyst (Strength & Conditioning): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Strength and Conditioning / Sports and Exercise Science / Sports Science; OR Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Sports Coaching / Physical Education / Performance Coaching with specified Strength & Conditioning certifications (ACSM, NSCA-CSCS, ASCA, UKSCA, NCCA USCCA, NSNIS PG Diploma, NSDC Level 4/6/7, government-recognized gym/fitness certifications, EXOS with ACSM credits); desirable 1 year experience in Strength & Conditioning.
  • Performance Analyst (Nutrition): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Nutrition & Dietetics / Food Science & Nutrition / Sports Nutrition / Nutrition / Food & Nutrition / Food Nutrition & Dietetics / Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics / Home Science with specified Nutrition specializations; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Nutrition.
  • Performance Analyst (Biomechanics): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Biomechanics / Sports Biomechanics / Sports Biomechanics & Kinesiology / Kinesiology (with Biomechanics) / Exercise & Sports Sciences (with Biomechanics) / Human Movement Sciences / Sports Sciences (with Biomechanics) / Biophysics / Physiotherapy (MPT Sports Biomechanics) with Biomechanics as major subject; with specified equivalent Bachelor’s degrees; desirable 1 year experience in Biomechanics.

2. Age Limit

  • Maximum Age: Up to 30 years as on the opening date for submission of online application forms.
  • SC/ST: Relaxation up to 5 years.
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): Relaxation up to 3 years.
  • Ex-servicemen: Relaxation as per Ex-servicemen (Re-employment in Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979.
  • Departmental/SAI contractual employees: Relaxation as per detailed SAI guidelines, including service-based cumulative relaxation.
  • Date of Birth Proof: As recorded in Matriculation/Secondary or equivalent certificates; no other documents accepted for age proof.

3. Nationality

Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply for SAI Performance Analyst posts.

Selection Process for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

The selection process will be based on a Computer-Based Test (CBT) with the following structure:

  • Mode: Computer-Based Test (CBT) in fully proctored environment with biometric authentication.
  • Duration: 2 hours.
  • Total Questions: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.

Sections of CBT:

  • Section A (Common for all disciplines):
    • Basic Sports Science Knowledge (Section A1) – 32 marks.
    • General Sports Awareness (Section A2) – 8 marks.
    • Total: 40 marks.
  • Section B (Discipline-specific): Applied Sports Science Knowledge – 40 marks.
  • Section C (Discipline-specific): Sports-related Case Studies (passage/analytical) – 20 marks.

Final Merit List: Prepared solely on total CBT marks (out of 100). No additional weightage or supplementary evaluation is applied. Tie-breaking will follow sequential criteria based on marks in Sections C, B, A, A1, A2, then age (older candidate) and alphabetical order of name.

  7. Pay the application fee online using NEFT/RTGS/Net Banking/UPI as per category.

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (Passed 2021-2025)

  • Category I - Graduate Apprentices (Engineering): BE/BTech from AICTE-recognized university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).
  • Category II - Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Diploma from recognized board/university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).
  • Category III - Graduate Apprentices (General Stream): BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BMS/BJMC/BBS from UGC-recognized university.
  • No additional weightage for higher qualifications.

Age Limit (As on 01.01.2026)

  • Maximum Age: 25 Years
  • Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL (subject to certificates at DV).

  • Valid approved NATS ID (register on NATS portal).
  • No previous/current apprenticeship under Apprentices Act.
  • Physical fitness certificate from Govt. Doctor (Assistant Surgeon rank) in prescribed format; final medical by KRCL authority.
  • Indian nationals only.

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Recruitment 2026

  • For candidates belonging to SC /ST/Female/ minorities / Economically Weaker Section: Nil
  • For all Other candidates: Rs 100/-

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Selection Process

Selection will be based on:

  1. Merit List: Aggregate percentage of all semesters/years (no rounding, no weightage per semester).
  2. Tie-Breaker: Older age, then earlier matriculation exam pass date.
  3. Shortlisting: 3 times the vacancies called for first round of Document Verification (DV); more if needed.
  4. Final medical fitness by KRCL.

No written exam or interview. Candidature cancelled if discrepancies found.

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Stipend

  • Graduate Apprentices: ₹9,000 per month (₹4,500 Govt share via DBT + ₹4,500 KRCL share).
  • Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: ₹8,000 per month (₹4,000 Govt share via DBT + ₹4,000 KRCL share).
  • No lodging/boarding provided; candidates arrange own.

How to Apply for KRCL Trainee Apprentices Recruitment 2026

Follow these steps:

  1. Register on NATS portal and get approved NATS ID.
  2. Visit KRCL website: https://konkanrailway.com.
  3. Go to Quick Links → Graduate Apprentice/Technician Apprentice.
  4. Read notification and fill online application form (keep email/mobile active).
  5. Upload photo and signature (mandatory).
  6. Pay processing fee online: ₹100 (General/OBC-NCL/EWS), Nil (SC/ST/Female/Minorities).
  7. Submit and print confirmation (no hard copy to send).
  8. Shortlisted candidates appear for DV with originals and photocopies.

Important Notes:

  • Apply for correct slot based on qualification; wrong slot leads to rejection.
  • No TA/DA for DV.
  • Keep Aadhaar-linked bank account and PAN for stipend.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)

  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation

  • Eligible Disabilities:

    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)

    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess the following minimum educational qualification for the post of Deputy General Manager (Mech.) – Bulk Material Handling Expert (VC No. CP/07/26):

  • Full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or
  • Full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Technology in Mechanical / Production / Production & Industrial / Manufacturing / Mechanical / Railways / Mechatronics & Automobile or any of the above combinations in part or whole.
  • Degree must be recognized by AICTE and obtained from a University incorporated by an Act of Central or State Legislature in India or other Educational Institutions established by an Act of Parliament or declared to be Deemed University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956.
  • Sections A & B examination of the Institution of Engineers (India), treated as equivalent to Degree by Govt. of India and recognized by AICTE, shall also be accepted.
  • UR/EWS candidates (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD applying against unreserved posts) must have first class degree / minimum 60% marks in the minimum qualification.
  • Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD as applicable) should have at least 50% marks in the minimum qualification for consideration against reserved posts.

If the certificate/mark sheet does not indicate first class/division or percentage, candidates must provide the conversion formula issued by the concerned university/institution. Where no formula exists, an undertaking from the university/institution is required, and minimum 6 on 10-point scale will be considered as 60%.

2. Minimum Post-Qualification Experience

Candidates should have the following minimum post-qualification experience (post degree) for CP/07/26:

  • Minimum 09 years’ experience in designing and optimizing bulk material handling systems.
  • Ability to develop process flow diagrams, capacity calculations, and optimization studies.
  • Experience and proficiency in material handling systems such as conveyors, stackers, reclaimers, ship loaders/unloaders, silos, wagon tipplers, and rapid loading systems.
  • Proven capability in project lifecycle management from feasibility to commissioning.
  • Experience in cost estimation, budgeting and lifecycle analysis of CAPEX and OPEX.

The period of training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship, and PhD research experience shall not be counted as part of experience.

3. Age Limit & Relaxations

  • Maximum age for UR: 50 years as on 08.03.2026.
  • SC/ST: Relaxation of 5 years in upper age limit.
  • OBC–NCL: Relaxation of 3 years in upper age limit.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Relaxation of 10 years in addition to category relaxation, subject to post being identified suitable.

PwBD candidates will have to meet the physical requirements and functional classifications identified for Mechanical posts (Locomotor disability – OA/OL with specified physical requirements).

4. Nationality

Candidates must be eligible to work in India as per applicable laws and guidelines as implied in the notification.

Selection Process for RITES Deputy General Manager (Mech.) – Bulk Material Handling Expert 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Document Scrutiny/Verification: All candidates who have successfully submitted their online application will be provisionally allowed for document scrutiny/verification to determine eligibility with respect to the post applied.
  • Interview: Shortlisted and eligible candidates after document scrutiny shall be allowed to appear for Interview. RITES Ltd. reserves the right to shortlist candidates for selection out of eligible applicants.
  • Interview Weightage: 100% weightage to Interview (Technical & Professional proficiency – 65%; Personality, Communication & Competency – 35%).
  • Qualifying Marks in Interview: Minimum 60% marks for UR/EWS candidates and 50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts are required for being considered for placement on panel. There is no minimum qualifying marks requirement in aggregate.
  • Medical Examination: Appointment will be subject to candidates being found medically fit as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness for the relevant post.

Reservation/relaxation/concessions for EWS/SC/ST/OBC–NCL/PwBD/Ex-SM/J&K Domicile will be provided against reserved posts, wherever applicable, as per Government orders.

How To Apply

Eligible candidates can apply online for RITES Ltd. Deputy General Manager (Mech.) – Bulk Material Handling Expert 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: www.rites.com and go to the Career section.
  2. Open the online registration format under the relevant advertisement for VC No. CP/07/26.
  3. Fill the online application form carefully with correct personal, educational, experience and category details.
  4. Note down the system-generated Registration No. which appears on top of the online form and use it for all future communication with RITES Ltd.
  5. Enter details of “Identity Proof” correctly and ensure availability of the same document in original for later verification.
  6. Under the “Fill/Modify Application Form” section, complete all required fields and then upload all supporting documents in the “Upload Document” section.

Upload mandatory documents including proof of date of birth, educational and professional qualifications with mark sheets, percentage conversion document (if applicable), category certificates, proof of identity and address, PAN card, and experience documents (offer letters, joining orders, relieving letters, service certificates, pay slips, etc.) in a single PDF in chronological order wherever required.
  8. After uploading documents, proceed to the “Make Payment” section and pay the applicable application fee online.
  9. On successful fee payment, download and save the final application form. Retain a printed copy of the application form for future reference and carry it along with self-attested copies of documents, if called for document verification/selection process.

Applications without successful fee payment will be treated as incomplete and will be summarily rejected. Hard copies of documents are not required to be sent by post/courier.

  • Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen candidates is applicable as per extant rules, for the posts which carry Pay of and up to the Level-6E (35900-113500).
  • In terms of S.O. 361 of 2021 dated 20.10.2021, an Ex-Servicemen on joining any post after having availed Horizontal Reservation, cannot avail the benefit of Horizontal Reservation as Ex-Servicemen for any subsequent Employment. Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Written Examination:
    • Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions
    • Questions will be set in English Language only
    • Negative marking: One-fourth marks deduction for each wrong answer

  • Stage 2 - Physical Standard Test (PST):
    • Qualifying nature only
    • Candidates shortlisted: Six times the total vacancies in each category based on written test merit
    • Male: Height 5'-6", Chest 32" (unexpanded), 33½" (expanded)

  • Board's decision on all matters shall be final and binding

  • Final merit list shall be prepared from the aggregate marks obtained in both academic and interview stages. (b) Need Based Teachers/Contractual Teachers recruited under the Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Jharkhand will get 01 additional mark per year of continuous teaching, upto a maximum of additional 5 marks. However, the total marks awarded to such Need Based Teachers/Contractual Teachers out of 80 for Academic record/achievements shall be capped at 80 marks.
