Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview

General Information/Instructions

  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) is an apex organization for Educational Research, Teacher Training and Development of Curriculum and Instructional material in school education

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (Passed 2021-2025)

  • Category I - Graduate Apprentices (Engineering): BE/BTech from AICTE-recognized university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).
  • Category II - Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Diploma from recognized board/university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).
  • Category III - Graduate Apprentices (General Stream): BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BMS/BJMC/BBS from UGC-recognized university.
  • No additional weightage for higher qualifications.

Age Limit (As on 01.01.2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age: 25 Years
  • Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL (subject to certificates at DV).

Additional Requirements

  • Valid approved NATS ID (register on NATS portal).
  • No previous/current apprenticeship under Apprentices Act.
  • Physical fitness certificate from Govt. Doctor (Assistant Surgeon rank) in prescribed format; final medical by KRCL authority.
  • Indian nationals only.

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Recruitment 2026

  • For candidates belonging to SC /ST/Female/ minorities / Economically Weaker Section: Nil
  • For all Other candidates: Rs 100/-

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Selection Process

Selection will be based on:

  1. Merit List: Aggregate percentage of all semesters/years (no rounding, no weightage per semester).
  2. Tie-Breaker: Older age, then earlier matriculation exam pass date.
  3. Shortlisting: 3 times the vacancies called for first round of Document Verification (DV); more if needed.
  4. Final medical fitness by KRCL.

No written exam or interview. Candidature cancelled if discrepancies found.

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Stipend

  • Graduate Apprentices: ₹9,000 per month (₹4,500 Govt share via DBT + ₹4,500 KRCL share).
  • Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: ₹8,000 per month (₹4,000 Govt share via DBT + ₹4,000 KRCL share).
  • No lodging/boarding provided; candidates arrange own.

How to Apply for KRCL Trainee Apprentices Recruitment 2026

Follow these steps:

  1. Register on NATS portal and get approved NATS ID.
  2. Visit KRCL website: https://konkanrailway.com.
  3. Go to Quick Links → Graduate Apprentice/Technician Apprentice.
  4. Read notification and fill online application form (keep email/mobile active).
  5. Upload photo and signature (mandatory).
  6. Pay processing fee online: ₹100 (General/OBC-NCL/EWS), Nil (SC/ST/Female/Minorities).
  7. Submit and print confirmation (no hard copy to send).
  8. Shortlisted candidates appear for DV with originals and photocopies.

Important Notes:

  • Apply for correct slot based on qualification; wrong slot leads to rejection.
  • No TA/DA for DV.
  • Keep Aadhaar-linked bank account and PAN for stipend.

1. ERP Head (Supervisor/Consultant) – 1 Post

Essential Qualification: B.E/B.Tech/M.C.A

Essential Experience: Minimum 10 years of experience in implementing, configuring and supporting ERP systems.

Desirable Skills:

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end processes, finance and statutory compliance.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Working experience in Agile Methodology.
  • Project experience in ERP development in Academic Institutions.
  • Technical skills: proficiency in database management (e.g., MS SQL), familiarity with integration tools and APIs.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Participate in scrum calls; supervise and coordinate daily activities of the ERP implementation team.
  • Convert business requirements to system requirements.
  • Draft user stories, epics, product backlog and documentation.
  • Handle and guide the implementation team.

Age Limit: 50 years (Age relaxation may be given to exceptional candidates).

2. Database Administrator – 1 Post

Essential Qualification: B.E/B.Tech/M.C.A or equivalent.

Essential Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in database administration.

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Proficiency in SQL, PL/SQL.
  • Knowledge of ETL processes.
  • Knowledge of relational database design and normalization.
  • Good knowledge of performance-tuning queries and complex stored procedures.
  • Preference for IT experts from other IITs (willing to serve on deputation).

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and maintain efficient and reliable SQL queries, stored procedures, views and triggers.
  • Optimize and tune SQL queries for performance improvements.
  • Manage database security, data integrity and backups.
  • Collaborate with application developers to design database schemas and structures.
  • Create and maintain documentation for databases, procedures and data flows.
  • Develop ETL processes to support data migration and transformation.
  • Monitor database performance and troubleshoot issues.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy and security regulations.

Age Limit: 45 years (Age relaxation may be given to exceptional candidates).

Salary: ₹ 40,000 – 60,000 per month (consolidated), based on experience and competency.

Contract Period: 1 year, extendable up to 3 years based on performance; 5% salary increase on extension.

3. Developer – 1 Post

Essential Qualification: B.E/B.Tech/M.C.A or equivalent.

Essential Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in relevant field.

Desirable Skills:

  • Expertise in JavaScript, React JS.
  • HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, and working knowledge of SQL.
  • Familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms.
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting languages (JavaScript, PL/SQL).
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Preference for IT experts from other IITs (willing to serve on deputation).

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Build web and mobile applications using low-code/no-code platforms.
  • Configure UI components, data models, workflows and business logic using visual tools.
  • Integrate applications with databases, APIs and other external services.
  • Perform unit testing and assist in system/integration testing.
  • Deploy applications to test and production environments.

Age Limit: 45 years (Age relaxation may be given to exceptional candidates).

Salary: ₹ 40,000 – 60,000 per month (consolidated), based on experience and competency.

Q1. What is the nature of these positions?

A1. These are purely contractual positions for 1 year initially, extendable up to 3 years based on performance and institute requirement. No claim for permanent appointment or regularization will be entertained.

Q2. What are the qualifications required?

A2. All posts require B.E/B.Tech/M.C.A or equivalent from Government-recognized universities/institutions.

Q3. What is the experience requirement?

A3. ERP Head: Minimum 10 years in ERP implementation; Database Administrator: Minimum 3 years in database administration; Developer: Minimum 2 years in the relevant field.

Q4. What is the age limit?

A4. ERP Head: 50 years; Database Administrator: 45 years; Developer: 45 years. Age relaxation may be given to exceptional candidates on the recommendation of the selection committee.

Q5. What is the salary offered?

A5. ERP Head: ₹ 1,00,000 – 1,20,000 per month; Database Administrator & Developer: ₹ 40,000 – 60,000 per month (consolidated), with a possible 5% increase on extension.

Q6. When is the application deadline?

A6. The last date for online application submission is 08-03-2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered.

Q7. How do I apply?

A7. Apply online only through the IIT Dharwad website (https://www.iitdh.ac.in/announcement). Hard copy submission is not required.

Q8. What is the application fee?

A8. The application fee is ₹ 200/- (including GST), payable only through State Bank e-collect facility. The fee is non-refundable.

Q9. What benefits are provided to selected candidates?

A9. Selected candidates are not entitled to regular employee benefits such as housing, medical facility, PF, pension, gratuity, seniority or promotion.

Q10. What happens after I submit my application?

A10. A confirmation email will be sent to your registered email ID. Further communication regarding tests, interviews and results will be through email and the official website, so candidates should check them regularly.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

  • Candidates must possess the trade-wise qualifications listed above.
  • Qualifications must be obtained through regular full-time mode; Distance Learning, Part Time and Correspondence modes are not acceptable.
  • Candidates having higher/professional qualifications than those prescribed are not eligible to apply.

2. Apprenticeship Status

  • Candidates currently undergoing Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in any Govt./Public Sector/Private industrial establishment are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates who have already undergone Apprenticeship Training in IREL or any other organization are not eligible.

3. Age Limit

  • Minimum age: 18 years as on the last date of application.
  • Maximum age: 25 years as on the last date of application.
  • Age relaxation: SC/ST up to 5 years; OBC (NCL) up to 3 years; PWBD up to 10 years.

Age Limit

  • As on the last date of application, the candidate should be between 18 and 25 years of age.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per Government guidelines: SC/ST – 5 years; OBC (NCL) – 3 years; PWBD – 10 years.
  • Proof of age must be supported by Matriculation/10th certificate or Birth Certificate.

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on merit list prepared from marks scored in the specified educational qualification, subject to being found “Medically Fit” by the company’s authorised Doctor.
  • In case of tie, higher marks in the qualifying exam will be considered; if still equal, elder candidate (earlier date of birth) will be given preference.
  • Priority order for selection at Rare Earths Division:
    • Candidates belonging to Land Affected Category (if applicable, with documentary proof).
    • Candidates from peripheral villages within 10 km radius of RED and wards of serving/deceased employees of IREL.
    • Candidates from Ernakulam District.
    • Candidates from Kerala State.
    • Others.
  • Merit list candidates will be called for document verification; originals and self-attested photocopies of all required documents must be produced.
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo medical examination and be declared “Medically Fit” before engagement.
  • Entry to RED, a highly protected area, requires submission of Police Verification Certificate from the concerned Police authorities prior to joining.
  • Final selection and department allocation within the unit are at the discretion of management; there is no obligation to offer regular employment during or after apprenticeship.

Application Fee

The advertisement does not specify any application fee for engagement of apprentices at IREL Rare Earths Division.

How To Apply

    • Trade Apprentices: Register in the apprenticeship portal of Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (if not already registered).
  2. Apply through Establishment Registration Numbers:
    • Trade Apprentices: Apply against Establishment Registration No. E11153200006.
    • Technician & Graduate Apprentices: Apply against Establishment Registration No. SKLERC000015.
  3. Download & Fill Application (Annexure-A): Fill the application in the prescribed proforma (preferably on A4 size paper) as given in the advertisement.
  4. Prepare Scanned Documents: Scan and self-attest photocopies of:
    • 10th Pass/Matriculation Certificate or Birth Certificate (proof of date of birth).
    • 10th Mark Sheet.
    • SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/Disability certificates (as applicable) in prescribed format.
    • Declaration form for OBC-NCL, if applicable.
    • All semester/year-wise mark sheets and final certificate of ITI/Diploma/Degree, as applicable to the apprentice category.
    • Nativity Certificate.
    • Aadhaar Card.
    • Proof of enrollment/registration in the respective apprenticeship portal (NATS/NAPS).
  5. Email Submission: Send the scanned copy of duly filled application form affixed with passport size photograph along with all supporting documents to [email protected].
  6. Subject Line: Mention in email subject: “APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT OF APPRENTICES AGAINST NOTIFICATION NO. IREL/RED/HRM/Apprentices Engagement/2026-27/01”.
  7. Ensure that the email with complete scanned application and documents reaches on or before 15/03/2026; applications after this date will not be considered.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates Should Posses 12TH, 10TH, 8TH Pass 

Class 10th /Matric pass with 45% marks in aggregate of five basic subjects and min 33% marks in each of those five subjects. For boards following grading system, grades commensurate to percentages, as above, will be considered. Indian Gorkhas – Class 10th simple pass.

Note: Candidates who have appeared in class 10th Board Exam and are awaiting declaration of results are also eligible to apply provided they fulfill all other Qualification Required.  Age Limit

Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

  • Upper Age limit will be relaxable upto 30 years of age (as on date of joining training) in respect of widows of Defence personnel who have died in harness.
  • Note: Women who are widowed, divorced or legally separated are also eligible provided they do not have any children subject to fulfilling all other eligibility criteria. Widows of Defence Personnel who have died in harness will be eligible to apply for enrolment as Women Military Police. Such widows even with children will be, however, eligible only if they have not remarried.

  • Chest Expansion: The candidate should be capable of chest expansion of 05 cms.
  • Weight: Weight standards are based on BMI as per the chart below.

  • Gorkhas.
  • Garhwalis.
  • Ladakher.
  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

    • Reasoning: 40 questions (50 marks) - 25 minutes

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Class 10th /Matric pass with 45% marks in aggregate of five basic subjects and min 33% marks in each of those five subjects. For boards following grading system, grades commensurate to percentages, as above, will be considered. Indian Gorkhas – Class 10th simple pass.

Widows of Defence Personnel who have died in harness will be eligible to apply for enrolment as Women Military Police. Such widows even with children will be, however, eligible only if they have not remarried.

Special Physical Standards

Candidates belonging to following regions will be given 4 cms height relaxation:

  • Gorkhas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

Candidates must carry the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies at the rally site (Phase II):

  • Admit Card.
  • 20 copies of passport size photographs.
  • Education Certificates (Marksheets, Degree, etc.).
  • Domicile Certificate.
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable for relaxation).
  • Religion Certificate (if required).
  • School Character Certificate.
  • Character Certificate from Village Sarpanch/Municipal Corporation.
  • Unmarried Certificate.
  • NCC Certificate (if applicable).
  • Sports Certificate (if applicable).
  • Affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper as per format.
  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official RIICO website. The last date to submit the application form is 07-03-2026. In this article, you’ll find the RIICO Junior Assistant, Draughtsman and Other Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

RIICO Recruitment 2026 Overview

Abbreviation used:

  • B/LV - Blindness/Low Vision
  • D - Deaf, HH - Hearing Impaired
  • LD - Locomotor Disability, CP - Cerebral Palsy, LC - Leprosy Cured, Dw - Dwarfism, AAV - Acid Attack Victims, MDy - Muscular Dystrophy
  • ASD - Autism Spectrum Disorder, ID - Intellectual Disability, SLD - Specific Learning Disability, MI - Mental Illness
  • MD - Multiple Disabilities

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification:

  • Company Secretary: Must have passed final examination of The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) and shall hold the Membership of the said Institute. Must have minimum of Five years' experience as Company Secretary in a Company having minimum paid capital of Rs 50 Crore or more.
  • Assistant Town Planner: Degree in Architecture (5 years full time course) with minimum 60% marks and Post Graduation in Town Planning from recognized University.
  • Programmer: B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. in Information Technology/Computer Science/Engineering or Electronics and Communications or M.C.A. from a recognized University OR ME/M.Tech degree in Information Technology or Computer Science/Engineering or Electronics and Communications from a recognized University OR B.Com with minimum 60% Marks from recognized university WITH Certificate Course in Information Technology (RSCIT/DOEACC "O" Level/COPA/DPCS/Diploma in Computer Science/Computer Applications/Information Technology).
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Degree/Diploma/Certificate of CA/CMA from the institute of ICAI/ICMAI from a recognized university OR B.Com with minimum 60% Marks from recognized university WITH Certificate Course in Information Technology (RSCIT/DOEACC "O" Level or Higher/COPA/DPCS certificate/Diploma in Computer Science).
  • Junior Legal Officer: Law graduate (Professional Degree) from a recognized university with minimum 55% marks or LL.M. from a recognized university.
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Senior Secondary from a recognized Board or its equivalent examination AND Higher Level Certificate Course conducted by DOEACC under control of the Department of Electronics, Government of India OR Certificate Course on computer concept by NIELIT, New Delhi OR Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA)/Data Preparation and Computer Software (DPCS) certificate OR Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer applications OR Senior Secondary Certificate with Computer Science/Computer Application as one of the subjects OR Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering from a polytechnic institution OR RSCIT OR Any equivalent or higher qualification.
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Diploma in Architecture from Polytechnic from recognized institute alongwith knowledge of AUTOCAD software OR Certificate course of Draughtsman (Civil) from National Council of Vocational Trade alongwith knowledge of AUTOCAD software.
  • Junior Assistant: Senior Secondary from a recognized Board or its equivalent examination AND "O" or Higher Level Certificate Course conducted by DOEACC OR Certificate Course on computer concept by NIELIT, New Delhi OR Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA)/Data Preparation and Computer Software (DPCS) certificate OR Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer applications OR Senior Secondary Certificate with Computer Science/Computer Application as one of the subjects OR Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering OR RSCIT OR Any equivalent or higher qualification.

Citizenship:

  • A citizen of India
  • A subject of Nepal
  • A subject of Bhutan
  • A Tibetan refugee who came over to India before 1st January, 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka or East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India

Note: Candidates belonging to categories (b), (c), (d) and (e) above shall be a person in whose favour a certificate of eligibility has been issued by the Home Department and Justice Department of Government of India.

Salary/Stipend

Appointment of selected candidates will be made for Probation Period for an initial period of two years. A fixed remuneration shall be payable to such candidates during the probation period:

  • Company Secretary: Level-16, Rs.4,7200/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Assistant Town Planner: Level-14, Rs.3,9300/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Programmer: Level-12, Rs.3,1100/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Level-11, Rs.2,6500/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Junior Legal Officer: Level-10, Rs.2,3700/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Level-10, Rs.2,3700/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Level-8, Rs.1,8500/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Junior Assistant: Level-5, Rs.1,4600/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)

Note: On successful completion of Probation Period, the salary shall be payable in regular Pay-Matrix. The regular salary with other allowances shall be paid, as per rules.

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: Less than 40 years

Age Relaxation:

  • SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS Male Candidates of Rajasthan State: 5 years relaxation
  • General Category Women Candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS Women Candidates of Rajasthan State: 10 years relaxation
  • Differently Abled Persons: Additional 5 years relaxation beyond the above-mentioned relaxations
  • Widow and Divorcee: No upper age limit, but at the time of appointment, their age should be less than the age of superannuation fixed by RIICO

Note: The provisions for relaxation in upper age limit are non-cumulative i.e. the benefit of any one provision shall be given for relaxation in upper age limit.

Application Fee

Category Fee for Post 1-6 Fee for Post 7-8
Unreserved (General) category and Creamy Layer category of BC/MBC of Rajasthan Rs.700/- Rs.1,000/-
Non-Creamy Layer category of BC/MBC of Rajasthan and EWS of Rajasthan Rs.525/- Rs.750/-
All Specially Abled Persons and SC/ST of Rajasthan Rs.350/- Rs.500/-

Special Note:

  • Candidates of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS of a State other than Rajasthan/Union Territories shall be treated as a candidate of General category and are liable to pay the examination fee as fixed for the General category candidates.
  • According to Circular dated 02.05.2018, the candidate's fee for candidates of all categories whose annual income of family is less than Rs.2.50 lakhs shall be payable same as of the candidates of SC/ST.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 20/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 21/01/2026
Extended Online Application Last Date 07/03/2026 (11:59 PM)
Examination Date To be announced
Admit Card Release Date To be announced

Selection Process

  • Selection of the candidates shall be made through a competitive examination conducted online.
  • The merit list shall be prepared on the basis of marks secured in the examination.
  • All questions in written examination paper shall be objective type.

Examination Structure:

  • Company Secretary: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Interview (50 Marks) = Total 400 Marks
  • Assistant Town Planner: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Programmer: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Junior Legal Officer: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Junior Assistant: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks

Note:

  • Only those candidates who have obtained minimum qualifying marks shall be eligible for appearing in the proficiency test.
  • Maximum five times of candidates of respective vacancies of the posts shall be called for appearing in the proficiency test.
  • For Company Secretary post, candidates who qualify in the written examination will be called for an interview. The number of candidates called for the interview will be five times the number of advertised vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

Reservation Policy:

  • 5% reservation shall be admissible to More Backward Class (non-creamy layer) belonging to State of Rajasthan.
  • 10% reservation shall be admissible to Economically Weaker Section of the State of Rajasthan.
  • Horizontal reservation of vacancies for women shall be 30% category-wise.
  • Out of the 30% reserved posts for women, 8% posts are reserved for widows and 2% for divorced women.
  • 2% reservation for Outstanding Sports Person (horizontal reservation).
  • Reservation for specially abled persons is also horizontal reservation.

Important Points:

  • The benefit of reserved posts of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS is only admissible to bonafide residents of the State of Rajasthan.
  • Candidates of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS of a State other than Rajasthan State/Union Territories shall be treated as candidates of General category.
  • According to judgment by Supreme Court and Rajasthan High Court, a woman of a State other than Rajasthan State who becomes bonafide resident of Rajasthan State after marriage, the benefit of reservation in SC/ST/OBC/MBC category shall not be allowed to her for public employment.
  • Married female candidates of BC/MBC are required to submit certificate on the basis of father's name, residence and income. Certificate on the basis of husband shall not be valid.
  • No candidate having more than two children on or after 01.04.2007 shall be eligible for appointment to the service.
  • Registration of marriage has been made compulsory for appointment in the services of state from 22.01.2006.
  • The candidate who smokes and/or consumes gutkha will not be eligible for appointment.

Special Instructions:

  • Candidates should fill the online application carefully. No change will be possible after clicking "Complete Registration" button.
  • Prior to filling online application, candidates must go through the detailed advertisement and service rules.
  • Candidates are required to upload Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression and Handwritten Declaration as per guidelines.
  • Mobile phone, Bluetooth, calculator, smart watch and any other electronic/communication devices are not permitted in examination hall.
  • Call letters shall be uploaded on the website www.riico.rajasthan.gov.in and no call letter will be sent by post.
  • Result of examination shall be communicated by uploading on the authorized website.
  • No travelling allowance/meal allowance shall be payable to candidates.

How to Apply

  • Candidates may visit the website www.riico.rajasthan.gov.in and click on the option "Apply Online".
  • To register the application, select the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter the name, contact details and email-id.
  • A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and sent through email and SMS.
  • Candidates can save the data by selecting "SAVE & NEXT" tab and can complete it later.
  • Before completing the registration, candidates should click on the Preview tab to preview and verify the entire application form.
  • After verifying all details, click on 'Complete Registration'.
  • Click on the 'Payment' tab and proceed for payment through online mode (Credit/Debit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets).
  • After successful payment, an e-receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-receipt and online application form.
  • Candidates should upload:
    • Recent colour photograph (maximum one month old) - Size: 20-50 KB, Dimensions: 200 x 230 Pixels
    • Signature (scanned) - Size: 10-20 KB, Dimensions: 140 x 60 Pixels
    • Left thumb impression - Size: 20-50 KB, Dimensions: 240 x 240 pixels
    • Handwritten declaration - Size: 50-100 KB, Dimensions: 800 x 400 pixels
    • Live photograph using webcam or mobile phone
  • All documents should be in JPG/JPEG format only.
  • After successful submission, take a printout of the application form for future reference.

Note:

  • Candidates should submit their online application in the prescribed time without waiting for the last date.
  • Any change/modification may disqualify the candidate if details don't match with certificates.
  • In case of applying through e-mitra or any other source, candidate must get submission in his/her presence.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency

  • Citizenship: A candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • Age Limit: A candidate must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years as on 1st January 2025; he/she must not have been born earlier than 2nd January 1983 and not later than 1st January 2004. Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST/SEBC/Women/Ex-Servicemen and by 10 years for PwD with permanent disability of 40% or more, with cumulative benefit for PwD of SC/ST/SEBC categories.
  • Educational Qualification (Essential): A candidate must hold a Bachelor’s Degree from any University incorporated by an Act of the Central or a State Legislature in India or an Educational Institution established by an Act of Parliament or deemed to be a University under Section-3 of the UGC Act, 1956 or a Foreign University approved by the Central Government from time to time.
  • Odia Language Requirement: The candidate must be able to read, write and speak Odia and must have passed Middle School Examination with Odia as a language subject OR passed High School Certificate or equivalent examination with Odia as medium of examination in non-language subjects OR passed Odia as a language subject in final examination of Class-VII from a recognised school OR passed a test in Odia in Middle English School standard conducted by the Government of Odisha.
  • Marital Status Condition: A candidate who has more than one spouse living or, in case of a woman candidate, is married to a person having one spouse living, shall not be eligible unless exempted by the State Government.
  • Government Servants: Government servants (temporary or permanent) are eligible, provided they possess requisite qualifications and are within the prescribed age limit and obtain No Objection Certificate from the competent authority.
  • Character & Health: A candidate must have good moral character and be of sound mental and physical health and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with the discharge of duties.

Salary/Stipend

  • For Odisha Police Service, Group-A (Junior Branch) – Group-A Service: Rs. 56,100/- in Level-12, Cell-1 in the Pay Matrix under Rule-3 of ORSP Rules, 2017.
  • For Group-B Services (Odisha Taxation & Accounts Service, Odisha Co-operative Service, Odisha Skill Development & Employment Service, Odisha Labour Service, Odisha Excise Service, Odisha Tourism Service): Rs. 44,900/- in Level-10, Cell-1 in the Pay Matrix under Rule-3 of ORSP Rules, 2017.

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 21 years.
  • Maximum Age: 42 years.
  • The candidate must not have been born earlier than 02/01/1983 and not later than 01/01/2004.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years for SC, ST, SEBC, Women and Ex-Servicemen candidates.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years for Persons with Disabilities having permanent disability of 40% or more; PwD candidates of SC/ST/SEBC categories are eligible for cumulative age relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Candidates other than SC, ST and PwD category shall have to pay examination fee of Rs. 700/- (Rupees Seven hundred only).
  • Payment Mode: Online mode while filling the Online Application Form (Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI, Net Banking, Wallet, etc.).
  • The examination fees paid shall be refunded only to those candidates who actually appear in both the papers of the Preliminary Examination.
  • Applications without payment of examination fee (except SC/ST/PwD candidates) will be treated as incomplete and summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must furnish bank account details in the Online Application Form for refund where required.

Important Dates

Event Date
Issue of Advertisement / Notice 31 December 2025
Start date for registration and payment of examination fee 20 January 2026
Last date for registration and payment of examination fee 20/02/2026 (5.00 P.M.)
Last date for submission of registered online application 27/02/2026 (5.00 P.M.)
Tentative date of Preliminary Examination of OCS-2025 07/06/2026 (Sunday)

Selection Process

  • The Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination shall comprise:
    • Preliminary Examination (Objective type) for selection of candidates for Main Examination.
    • Main Examination (Written) and Interview for Personality Test for selection to various services and posts.
  • Preliminary Examination: Two compulsory papers of Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions), General Studies Paper-I (200 marks) and General Studies Paper-II (200 marks), each of 2 hours duration.
  • General Studies Paper-II is a qualifying paper with minimum qualifying marks of 33; selection to Main Examination is based on marks in General Studies Paper-I and qualifying the Paper-II as per rules.
  • There shall be negative marking: for each wrong answer, one-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question shall be deducted; multiple answers to a question are treated as wrong.
  • Main Examination: Written examination consists of nine papers – two qualifying language papers (Odia and English) in Part-I and seven papers in Part-II (Essay, General Studies-I, II, III, IV and two Optional subject papers).
  • Marks obtained in Part-II papers and Interview (Personality Test) are counted for ranking; language papers in Part-I are qualifying in nature.
  • Interview (Personality Test) carries 250 marks; final ranking is based on total marks of Main Written and Interview.
  • Candidates are allotted to various Services based on ranks and service preference.

General Information/Instructions

  • The provisions of the Odisha Conduct of Examinations Act, 1988 are applicable; any violation or malpractice will attract disciplinary action and possible criminal prosecution.
  • Penalty provisions under Rule-18 of Odisha Civil Services Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination Rules, 1991 shall apply.
  • Reservation and relaxation benefits for SC, ST and SEBC are admissible only to those categories of Odisha.
  • Community/caste status once mentioned in the online application shall be treated as final and cannot be changed later.
  • The advertisement does not bind the Government to make appointment; the number of vacancies is subject to change without notice depending on public service requirements.
  • Misrepresentation or suppression of information in the online application will result in cancellation of candidature and penalty as decided by the Commission.
  • Mere empanelment in the select list does not confer any right to appointment unless the Government is satisfied about suitability after necessary enquiry.
  • No request for withdrawal of candidature or change of category will be entertained.
  • Candidates must carefully fill service/post preference; change of preference after submission of online application will not be allowed.
  • Candidates must answer papers in their own handwriting; only PwD candidates with specified disabilities may use a scribe as per rules.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must go through the detailed advertisement available on the website of OPSC before filling the Online Application Form.
  • Candidates must apply online through the OPSC website (https://opsc.gov.in).
  • The link for registration and payment of examination fee will be available from 20/01/2026 to 20/02/2026 (5.00 P.M.).
  • The last date for submission of registered online application is 27/02/2026 (5.00 P.M.).
  • Applications received through any mode other than online shall not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • After declaration of result of the Main Written Examination, candidates called for Interview/Personality Test will be required to submit print-out/hard copy of online application along with photocopies of documents as stated in the advertisement on the day of document verification.

Odisha.contentHtml:
Odisha Sub-ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC) RI, ARI and ICDS Supervisor and Other Notification 2026 has been released on 07-01-2026 on the official website https://osssc.gov.in. A total of 3,250 vacancies have been announced through the OSSSC Recruitment 2026 (Advt No. IIE-120/2025-3219/OSSSC).

Candidates aged 20 to 42 years (with applicable relaxations as per rules) who possess the required Post-wise educational qualifications and other eligibility conditions as prescribed in the Detailed Advertisement for CRE-2025 are eligible to apply for these vacancies.

The online application process for OSSSC RI, ARI and ICDS Supervisor and Other Recruitment 2026 has started on 07-01-2026 and will remain open until 06-03-2026 (including fee payment). Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

OSSSC Combined Posts Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC)
Post Name Revenue Inspector (RI), ICDS Supervisor, Village Agricultural Worker (VAW), Junior Assistant (JA), Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI), Amin & Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS)
No of Posts 3250
Salary Revenue Inspector, ICDS Supervisor: Pay Scale ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01
Village Agricultural Worker: Pay Scale ₹ 21700–69100, Pay Matrix Level-5, Cell-01
Junior Assistant, Assistant Revenue Inspector: Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01
Amin, Statistical Field Surveyor: Pay Scale ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01
Qualification Post-wise educational qualifications and other eligibility conditions as prescribed in the Detailed Advertisement for CRE-2025.
Age Limit 42 years as on 1st January, 2025 (post-wise as specified with admissible relaxations).
Start Date for Apply  07.01.2026
Last Date for Registration   06-03-2026
Official Website www.osssc.gov.in
