  • In the examination hall as well as at the time of interview, the call letter along with original and a photocopy of the candidate’s currently valid photo identity (bearing exactly the same name as it appears on the call letter) such as PAN Card/ Passport/ Permanent Driving License/ Voter’s Card/ Bank Passbook with photograph/ Photo identity proof issued by a Gazetted Officer on official letterhead along with photograph / Photo identity proof issued by a People’s Representative on official letterhead along with photograph / valid recent Identity Card issued by a recognized College/ University/ Aadhar card/ E-Aadhar Card with a photograph/ Employee ID/ Bar Council Identity Card with photograph should be submitted to the invigilator for verification. The candidate’s identity will be verified with respect to his/her details on the call letter, in the Attendance List and requisite documents submitted. If identity of the candidate is in doubt the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the Examination.
  • Ration Card and Learner’s Driving License are not valid id proof.
  • Note: Candidates must produce in original the photo identity proof and submit photocopy of the photo identity proof along with Examination call letter as well as the Interview Call Letter while attending the examination/ interview respectively, without which they will not be allowed to take up the examination/ interview. Candidates must note that the name as appearing on the call letter (provided during the process of registration) should exactly match the name as appearing on the photo identity proof. Female candidates who have changed first/last/middle name post marriage must take special note of this. If there is any mismatch between the name indicated in the Call Letter and Photo Identity Proof the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the examination. In case of candidates who have changed their name, will be allowed only if they produce original Gazette notification / their original marriage certificate / affidavit in original.
  • 1. The examination will be conducted at venues given in the respective call letters.
  • 2. No request for change of centre/venue/date/session for Examination shall be entertained.
  • 3. Export-Import Bank of India, however, reserves the right to cancel any of the Examination Centres and/ or add some other Centres, at its discretion, depending upon the number of candidates, administrative feasibility, etc.
  • 4. Export-Import Bank of India also reserves the right to allot the candidate to any Centre other than the one he/she has opted for.
  • 5. Candidate will appear for the examination at an Examination Centre at his/her own risks and expenses and Export-Import Bank of India will not be responsible for any injury, expense or losses etc. of any nature.
  • 6. Choice of centre once exercised by the candidate will be final. If sufficient number of candidates do not opt for a particular centre for examination, OR if the number of candidates is more than the capacity available for exam for a centre, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to allot any other centre to the candidate.
  • Decision of Export-Import Bank of India in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained by the Export-Import Bank of India in this behalf.
  • Export-Import Bank of India would be analysing the responses (answers) of individual candidates with those of other candidates to detect patterns of similarity of right and wrong answers. If in the analytical procedure adopted by Export-Import Bank of India in this regard, it is inferred/ concluded that the responses have been shared and scores obtained are not genuine/ valid, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to cancel the candidature of the concerned candidates and the result of such candidates (disqualified) will be withheld.
  • There will be no sectional cut off but the final list for interviews will be drawn based on the candidate’s performance in the written test.
  • Instances for providing incorrect information and/or process violation by a candidate detected at any stage of the selection process will lead to disqualification of the candidate from the selection process and he/she will not be allowed to appear in any recruitment process of Export-Import Bank of India in the future. If such instances go undetected during the current selection process but are detected subsequently, such disqualification will take place with retrospective affect.
  • A pre-recruitment training will be organised for the candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online / offline) will be intimated to the candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared with such candidates after the last date of registration.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the examination. In all such cases where a scribe is used, the following rules will apply:
  • • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination. If violation of the above is detected at any stage of the process, candidature of both the candidate and the scribe will be cancelled. Candidates eligible for and who wish to use the services of a scribe in the examination should invariably carefully indicate the same in the online application form. Any subsequent request may not be favourably entertained.
  • • A person acting as a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate.
  • • The scribe may be from any academic stream.
  • • Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned above. Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfil any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the examination.
  • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • • Scribe should not answer on his/her own. Any such behaviour observed will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same. Candidates not registered for compensatory time shall not be allowed such concessions.
  • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. The candidature of such candidates using the services of a scribe will also be cancelled if it is reported after the examination by the test administrator personnel that the scribe independently answered the questions.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.
  • These guidelines are subject to change in terms of GoI guidelines/ clarifications, if any, from time to time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online only from January 26, 2026, up to March 02, 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Scan their: Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), Signature (with black ink), Left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), A handwritten declaration (on a white paper with black ink) (text given below), The consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation, Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree, Caste Certificate (if applicable) Ensuring that all these scanned documents adhere to the required specifications as given in this Advertisement.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • The left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged. (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb for applying.)
  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

  • IAF Agniveer New Recruitment 2026

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Qualifications, experience, and expertise in cinematography/videography/ news-gathering / broadcast journalism.
  • Essential Qualification: Proof in Duplicate of Academic and Technical Qualifications, Experience and Equipment ownership must be submitted along with the Application.
  • Experience: Experience in TV News coverages for the 23 districts in the State of West Bengal.

Salary / Stipend

  • Stringers will be paid for coverages, irrespective of the length of footage or its usage, but inclusive of transportation and delivery charges.
  • (i) local coverage of duration of less than 6 Hours @ Rs. 1500 per coverage, and in case duration of 6 Hours is exceeded or when it involves locations apart from more than 10 kms, it will be treated as two coverages and the 2nd coverage will be paid @ Rs. 1,000.
  • (ii) In case of outstation coverage, which are coverages undertaken beyond the geographical limit of the District HQ where the Stringer is empanelled, the Stringer’s fee would be Rs. 1,800 irrespective of the length of the footage or usage of the coverage, inclusive of transportation and delivery charges.

Application Fee

  • Demand Draft of Rs. 1,180/- (inclusive of GST) towards non-refundable processing fee in favour of the “DDO, DDK, Kolkata” payable at Kolkata.

Important Dates

Last Date of Receipt of Application 04 March 2026 till 6:00 pm

Selection Process

  • Proof of ownership of the equipment must be submitted at the time of the interview, if shortlisted.
  • A physical verification of the equipment and documents will be done on the day of the interview.
  • A test coverage assignment will be given to all applicants for their submission to RNU before their interview date.
  • Submission of the test coverage assignment on time is essential for being called for the interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • Empanelled Stringers are expected to do news coverages and short features on news, current affairs, sports, business and other subjects. Applicants preferably equipped with four-wheel vehicles, should have qualifications, experience, and expertise in cinematography/videography/ news-gathering / broadcast journalism. Details of other terms and conditions prescribed in Guidelines issued by Directorate General, Doordarshan, New Delhi vide their Memo No. 3/4/2003-P-III dated 02.07.2010 are available in the Annexure to this notification.
  • Stringers should have adequate facilities and equipment to undertake the coverage.
  • The coverages by a stringer should contain all elements of a news story. For each coverage, the stringer should provide raw footage, press material and a script. Stringers should not only cover assigned tasks but also alert the RNU on major news fall/breaking stories/stories of interest in their area. The Panel of Stringers shall be revised every two years.

Stringers will be removed from the panel on all or any of the following grounds:

  1. When the Stringer refuses to cover the assigned coverages on two or more occasions;
  2. If the coverages are poor in content or in technical quality (poor audio quality, noisy video, variation in luminance level, defocused pictures, etc.);
  3. Delay in providing timely coverage;
  4. When the Stringer is suspected of subcontracting the assigned work to others;
  5. If the Stringers are found to be operating a cartel system among themselves;
  6. If the information furnished by the Stringer in the application form for empanelment is found to be incorrect.
  7. Any act on the part of the stringer that creates embarrassment to Prasar Bharati.

How to Apply

  • Applications duly supported with a Demand Draft of Rs. 1,180/- (inclusive of GST) towards non-refundable processing fee in favour of the “DDO, DDK, Kolkata” payable at Kolkata should be submitted in a sealed cover with superscription - “Empanelment of Stringers of RNU Kolkata, DD News- 2026” on or before the last date of submission of application.
  • The address for submitting the Application is: The Head, Regional News Unit, Doordarshan Kendra, 18/3, Uday Shankar Sarani, Kolkata-700095.
  • Proof in Duplicate of Academic and Technical Qualifications, Experience and Equipment ownership must be submitted along with the Application, whose model is given in this notification itself.
  • Separate Annexures can also be given along with the application detailing the experience or qualifications of the applicant and the team, if required.
  • For any clarification, write to [email protected].

  • General Manager (Production) - HR-01: Recognized Full-Time Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Production/Manufacturing/Electrical/Electronic with minimum 55% marks from recognized University/Institute. GATE SCORE OF 2025 is required

  • Junior Manager - Finance - HR-09: Passed Final examination of Institute of Chartered Accountants/Institute of Cost Accountants of India

Additional qualification/Certification in Exports/International Marketing/Foreign Trade will be an added advantage
  • Senior Manager - Marketing (Consumer Sales) - HR-14: MBA/PGDM (at least 02 years course) in Marketing/Sales/Operations/Public Procurement/Supply Chain Management from Recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE) OR Full-time Engineering Degree with minimum 55% from a Government-recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE). Additional qualification or certification in Rehabilitation, Medical Devices or Social Sector Management will be an added advantage
  • Manager (Market Research & Data Analysis) - HR-15: MBA/PGDM (at least 02 years course) with minimum 55% marks in any discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE) OR Full-time Engineering Degree with minimum 55% from a Government-recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE). Certification in Data Analytics/Data Science/Statistical Tools/Business Intelligence will be an added advantage
  • Deputy Manager - GeM Sales - HR-16: MBA/PGDM (at least 02 years course) with minimum 55% marks in any discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE) OR Full-time Engineering Degree with minimum 55% from a Government-recognized University/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE). Certification or formal training in GeM procurement, Government procurement rules, or e-tendering systems will be an added advantage
  • Junior Manager - Marketing (Direct Business Opportunity) - HR-17: Full Time MBA/PGDM Specialization in Marketing with minimum 55% marks from a Government recognized University/Institute
  • Prosthetic & Orthotic Officer - HR-18: Full Time Bachelor in Prosthetics & Orthotics. Registration in Central Rehabilitation Register (CRR) of RCI
  • Officer - Audiologist - HR-19: Full Time Bachelor in Audiology & Speech Language Pathology. Registration in Central Rehabilitation Register (CRR) of RCI
  • General Manager (Projects & Commercial) - HR-20: Full Time engineering degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Civil with minimum 55% marks from recognized university/institute. Master's Degree in any engineering discipline or PG Degree/PG Diploma with specialization in Projects Management/Contract Management/Materials/Marketing/TQM or other management discipline will be preferred
  • Safety Officer - HR-21: Possesses adequate knowledge of Hindi in Devnagri script AND meets one of the following: (1) Degree in any branch of Engineering or Technology with 2 years practical experience in factory supervisory capacity, OR (2) Degree in Physics or Chemistry with 5 years practical experience in factory supervisory capacity, OR (3) Diploma in any branch of Engineering or Technology with 5 years practical experience in factory supervisory capacity, OR (4) Recognized degree in Engineering or Technology with 5 years experience in Central/State Government departments dealing with Factories Act administration, OR (5) Recognized degree in Engineering or Technology with 5 years full-time experience in training, education, consultancy or research in accident prevention. AND Possesses a degree or diploma in industrial safety recognized by the State Government
  • Junior Manager (P&A) - HR-22: Recognized degree in any discipline and MBA (HR) with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Diploma in Personnel Management with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Personnel Management with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Diploma in HR Management with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in HR Management with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Diploma in IR Management with minimum 55% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in IR Management with minimum 55% marks OR Master of Social Work (MSW) with minimum 55% marks. Degree or Diploma should be from Recognized Institution (AIU or UGC or AICTE)
  • Welfare Officer - HR-23: A Degree from any University established by law in Social Sciences or Labour Welfare OR Industrial Relations and Personnel Management. Thorough knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari Script
  • Senior Manager (IT) - HR-24: Full time Engineering Degree in Computer Science with a minimum 55% marks from a Government recognized University/Institution OR Full time Engineering Degree in Information Technology with a minimum 55% marks from a Government recognized University/Institution OR Full time Master of Computer Applications with a minimum 55% marks from a Government recognized University/Institution
  • Specialist SAP FICO - HR-25: Full-Time Bachelor of Engineering with Minimum 55% Marks from a government recognized University/Institute OR CMA or CA from a government recognized University/Institute OR Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance from a government recognized University/Institute. SAP Certification will be added advantage
  • Specialist - SAP General & PM - HR-26: Full-Time Bachelor of Engineering with Minimum 55% Marks from a government recognized University/Institute. SAP Certification will be added advantage
  • Specialist - SAP SD - HR-27: Full-Time Bachelor of Engineering with 55% Marks from a government recognized University/Institute. SAP Certification will be added advantage
  • Specialist - SAP BASIS - HR-28: Full-Time Bachelor of Engineering with Minimum 55% Marks from a government recognized University/Institute. SAP Certification will be added advantage
  • AI Engineer/Data Scientist - HR-29: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field. At least 3 years of post-qualification experience in AI/ML engineering, with a strong focus on applications related to manufacturing industry
  • Manager - Design & Development (Electronics) - HR-30: Full-Time Engineering Degree in Electronics with minimum 55% marks from recognized university/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE)
  • Assistant Manager - (Design & Development) - HR-31: Full Time Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronic Engineering with minimum 55% marks from recognized university/institute
  • Junior Manager - Design & Development (Electronics) - HR-32: Full Time Engineering Degree in Electronics with minimum 55% marks from recognized university/Institute (AIU or UGC or AICTE)
  • Officer - O & M (Electrical/Electronics & Instrumentation) - HR-33: Full Time Engineering Degree in Electrical/Electronic/Instrumentation with minimum 55% marks from a Government recognized University/Institute. GATE Score Card - 2025 is required

Essential Qualifications

  • All essential qualifications should be from recognized Universities/Institutions approved by UGC/AICTE/Government of India as applicable
  • For GATE-based posts (HR-04 and HR-33), candidates must possess valid GATE 2025 score card
  • For professional qualifications like CA/ICWA/CS, candidates must have passed the final examination from respective institutes
  • For posts requiring registration with RCI (HR-18 and HR-19), candidates must be registered in Central Rehabilitation Register (CRR)
  • The prescribed qualifications are mandatory and in absence of the same any higher qualification even if possessed by the candidate does not make any candidate eligible
  • No age and percentage of marks bar for Departmental/Internal candidates who are on regular rolls or under Fixed Term Contracts with the corporation

Experience

  • General Manager Posts (HR-01, HR-05, HR-12, HR-20): Minimum 18 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector with eight years at senior management capacity. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediately lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Deputy General Manager Posts (HR-06, HR-13): Minimum 16 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediately lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Senior Manager Posts (HR-14, HR-24): Minimum 14 years post qualification experience in Government/PSU/reputed organizations. PSU/Government applicants should have minimum 02 years experience in the immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Manager Posts (HR-07, HR-15, HR-30): Minimum 12 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Deputy Manager Posts (HR-02, HR-08, HR-16): Minimum 10 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Assistant Manager (HR-31): Minimum 8 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing sector or research organization in field of design, research and development. Should have worked in immediate lower scale for at least 02 years. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Specialist SAP FICO (HR-25): Minimum 06 years of experience in SAP FICO with experience supporting general functions including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, Fixed Asset Accounting, Inter-company Accounting, and Project System. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Junior Manager Posts (HR-03, HR-09, HR-17, HR-22, HR-32): Minimum 05 years post qualification experience in Public Sector Undertaking or Reputed Private/Manufacturing Sector in respective domain. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Specialist SAP General & PM, SAP SD, SAP BASIS (HR-26, HR-27, HR-28): Minimum 05 years of experience in respective SAP modules. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • AI Engineer/Data Scientist (HR-29): At least 3 years of post-qualification experience in AI/ML engineering, with strong focus on applications related to manufacturing industry. Hands-on experience in developing and deploying AI models and machine learning algorithms for marketing and production environments. PSU/Government Applicant: 2 years in immediate lower scale. Private sector candidates must have comparable CTC in immediate lower scale
  • Accountant (HR-11): 04 Years in field of Accounting functions
  • Officer Level Posts (HR-04, HR-10, HR-18, HR-19, HR-21, HR-23, HR-33): For HR-04 and HR-33 - GATE 2025 score required with relevant knowledge. For HR-10 - Good knowledge in Accounts and Taxation. For HR-18 - Knowledge in fabrication and fitting of artificial limbs and conducting camps. For HR-19 - Knowledge to examine patients with hearing, balance, or related ear problems and conducting camps. For HR-21 - As per qualifications mentioned with practical experience requirements. For HR-23 - Knowledge in labour or Social Welfare Work in an organization or other social and administrative work
  • Teaching experience and training period will not be counted as experience
  • Candidates from private sector should be drawing minimum consolidated fixed monthly gross salary as specified for respective grades (E-7: Rs. 1,86,120/-, E-6: Rs. 1,65,440/-, E-5: Rs. 1,44,760/-, E-4: Rs. 1,24,080/-, E-3: Rs. 1,03,400/-, E-2: Rs. 82,720/-, E-1: Rs. 62,040/-, E-0: NIL). Monthly gross salary includes Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, HRA and other Fixed Perks and Allowance. No variable pay and incentive or reimbursement of expenses shall be considered
  • Wherever applicable, candidates must produce experience certificate as per required format during document verification

Desirable

  • All applicants should preferably have good computer knowledge and communication skills
  • Acquaintance with SAP shall be an added advantage for the candidates as Corporation's working is in SAP
  • For Deputy Manager - Production (Textile): Experience with SAP/ERP systems and export related process is desirable
  • For General Manager (Marketing): Knowledge of Corporate social responsibility, asset management, acquisition mergers contracts and negotiation, MOU etc. is desirable. Experience on manufacturing, distribution and supply of Artificial Limbs and Rehabilitation Aids, maintaining MIS on large domain, in/out bound logistics/SCM and CRM with logistics will be preferred. Knowledge of ERP is desirable
  • For Deputy General Manager - Marketing: Exposure to social sector/rehabilitation/healthcare/medical devices/assistive devices will be preferred
  • For Senior Manager - Marketing (Consumer Sales): Exposure to rehabilitation and healthcare/medical devices will be preferred
  • For Manager (Market Research & Data Analysis): Experience in the field of healthcare/rehabilitation/assistive devices/medical devices/social sector or public policy programs will be preferred
  • For General Manager (Projects & Commercial): Candidates having exposure in handling turn key projects of sizeable value of engineering industry will be preferred
  • For AI Engineer/Data Scientist: Experience with advanced optimization algorithms for marketing, supply chain and production scheduling. Familiarity with robotics and automation in Industries. Understanding of Industry 4.0 principles and smart marketing and manufacturing technologies. Prior experience in integrating AI with ERP/MES systems
  • For Junior Manager - Design & Development (Electronics): Knowledge of embedded firmware development for real-time applications using various microcontroller platforms is desirable

Salary/Stipend

  • E-7 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 1,00,000/- to Rs. 2,60,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 34,31,280/- (including Basic, IDA at 51.8%, Perks at 35%, HRA at 20%, Superannuation at 30% of Basic+DA, PRP/PLAI variable component)
  • E-6 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 90,000/- to Rs. 2,40,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 30,36,312/-
  • E-5 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 80,000/- to Rs. 2,20,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 26,52,864/-
  • E-4 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 70,000/- to Rs. 2,00,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 23,21,256/-
  • E-3 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,80,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 19,55,088/-
  • E-2 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 1,60,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 15,14,040/-
  • E-1 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 40,000/- to Rs. 1,40,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 13,03,392/-
  • E-0 Grade: Pay Scale Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 1,20,000/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 9,77,544/-. Officers at E-0 will be given basic salary of Rs. 30,000/- for initial 1 year. On confirmation after satisfactory performance after 1 year of joining, basic salary will be fixed at Rs. 36,000/- under same pay scale
  • Group-D: Pay Scale Rs. 18,790/- to Rs. 64,130/- per month. Approximate Annual CTC: Rs. 6,25,496/-
  • IDA (Industrial Dearness Allowance) changes every quarter based on AICPI. Current IDA for Oct-Dec 2025 quarter is 51.8%
  • The annual increment is 3% of the basic pay every year
  • HRA for metro cities is currently 30% and for other cities is 20%
  • In addition to basic pay, selected candidates would be entitled for DA, HRA, perks and other benefits like PF contribution of 12%, Pension Scheme, PRP, Incentive (PLAI), Indoor treatment, hospitalization facilities under Medical Rules, Post-Retirement Medical Scheme, Gratuity, Earned leave and casual leave as per the rules of the Corporation
  • The employee and dependents are covered under Hospitalization scheme as per Group Health Insurance Scheme of the Corporation
  • OPD facility also be provided up to one month basic plus DA in a financial year subject to submission of bill from Corporation empaneled hospitals/doctors
  • Even after superannuation, the employee and spouse can avail post-retirement medical benefit
  • The Corporation has its PF Trust and the share of both employee and employer is 12%. Rs. 1,250/- every month goes to FPF maintained by EPFO. Family Pension is admissible after attaining the age of 58 years
  • The corporation has taken up a superannuation policy with LIC of India where employees can contribute 10% and the corporation shall contribute 10% of the salary. At the time of superannuation, LIC calculates the Fund Corpus and fixes annuity for the life of the employee and thereafter his/her spouse

Age Limit (as on 01/01/2026)

  • E-7 Grade (General Manager Posts): Maximum age 55 years
  • E-6 Grade (Deputy General Manager Posts): Maximum age 52 years
  • E-5 Grade (Senior Manager Posts): Maximum age 50 years
  • E-4 Grade (Manager Posts): Maximum age 48 years
  • E-3 Grade (Deputy Manager and Specialist Posts): Maximum age 45 years
  • E-2 Grade (Assistant Manager Posts): Maximum age 42 years
  • E-1 Grade (Junior Manager and AI Engineer Posts): Maximum age 40 years
  • E-0 Grade (Officer Level Posts): Maximum age 30 years
  • Group-D (Accountant): Maximum age 34 years
  • The candidate should not have exceeded the age limit as of 01.01.2026. The date for reckoning the age, qualification, experience, etc. shall be 01.01.2026
  • No age and percentage of marks bar for Departmental/Internal candidates who are on the regular rolls of the Corporation or are under Fixed Term Contracts with the corporation
  • Relaxations for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS/PwBD (Divyangjan) candidates (Percentage of disability 40% or above) will be provided as per guidelines of Government of India
  • The SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates who apply against unreserved (UR) posts will not be eligible for age relaxation
  • PwBD (Divyangjan) candidates (Percentage of disability 40% or above) are eligible for age relaxations

Application Fee

  • For Executive Posts (E0-E7): Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only)
  • For Non-Executive Posts (Group-D): Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred Fifty only)
  • Exemption: SC/ST/PwBD and departmental candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee
  • Payment Mode: Candidates are required to visit the ALIMCO website (www.alimco.in), click on the "Career" option, and then select "Pay Recruitment Fee." They will be redirected to the SBI e-Collect page, where they must click on the "GOVT/PSU/COURTS" option and search for "ALIMCO"
  • Alternative Payment Mode: In case candidates face any issues while making the application fee payment through SBI e-Collect, they may deposit the fee using bank details: Account Name: M/S ALIMCO, Current Account Number: 10384171780, IFSC: SBIN0003962, Bank Name: State Bank of India, Branch Address: ALIMCO, G. T. Road, Naramau, Kanpur - 209217
  • After successful payment, candidates must download the payment receipt (PDF) and upload the same in the application form
  • After successful payment, candidates are required to mention/fill up the transaction details in the application form before submitting the online application
  • The application fee, once paid, shall be non-refundable and non-adjustable under any circumstances
  • The application fee shall be refunded in case management decides to cancel the process of recruitment of any post for any reason
  • The Corporation shall not be held responsible for any inadvertent error, omission, or technical issue arising during the payment of the application fee

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Notification Date 31/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 31/01/2026 (2:00 PM)
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 10/03/2026 (5:00 PM)
Last Date for Application Fee Payment Queries 06/03/2026 (5:00 PM)
Date for Reckoning Age, Qualification, Experience 01/01/2026

Selection Process

  • For most posts including General Managers, Deputy Managers, Managers, Junior Managers, and Officer level positions: Applications shall be scrutinized and eligible candidates will be called for a personal interview as per the recruitment policy of the Corporation. In case the number of eligible candidates in the ratio 1:20 (i.e., 20 applications exceeding on one post), the Corporation may conduct an online test prior to the interview. Average weightage will be 50% marks of the online test and 50% marks of the interview
  • For Specialist SAP Posts (HR-25 to HR-28): Selection shall be based on personal interview
  • For E-0 Level Posts - Accounts Officer (HR-10), P&O Officer (HR-18), Officer - Audiologist (HR-19): Selection shall be based on an online test
  • For Officer - Production (HR-04) and Officer - O&M (HR-33): Selection shall be based on marks obtained in the GATE-2025 scorecard
  • For Accountant (HR-11): Selection shall be based only on an online test
  • The candidature of all applicants shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates, testimonials, and other relevant documents
  • Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria/norms does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview/online test
  • Management reserves the right to call suitable/short-listed candidates for online test/interview/Skill test
  • Management reserves the right to raise standard of specifications i.e. qualification/percentage of marks/experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview
  • Management reserves the right to cancel candidature of any candidate or cancel recruitment process of any aforesaid post without assigning any reason

General Information/Instructions

  • ALIMCO (Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India) is a CPSU working under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
  • ALIMCO is a Government of India Undertaking 'Mini Ratna' Company
  • Recruitment is for ALIMCO HQ at Kanpur and its ALIMCO Auxiliary Production Centers at Bengaluru, Bhubaneshwar, Jabalpur, Mohali, Ujjain, Faridabad and Regional Marketing Centers at New Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Ranchi, Guwahati and Chennai
  • The applicant must be a Citizen of India
  • The number of vacancies indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of the management
  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD will be as per Government of India directives

The candidate may send advance copy of the application but may produce NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE at the time of interview/online or written test from their present Employer failing which they will not be allowed to appear
  • The candidates called for the Interview/Skill test will be reimbursed return rail/bus fare by shortest route on production of proof of journey from their present address to the place of interview as per the rules of the Corporation. No TA will be paid to any candidate for appearing in the online examination
  • Appointment to the post will be subject to being found medically fit by the Chief Medical Officer as per the prescribed Health Standards
  • The selected candidate will be posted in any of the offices/units/production centers of ALIMCO anywhere in India including in the initial posting as per the requirement of the corporation

  • During recruitment process, if any information provided by the candidate is found incorrect/incomplete or not in conformity with eligibility criteria, candidature shall be rejected/cancelled without assigning any reason. Similarly, even after joining, if found that incorrect information was furnished or material information was suppressed, services shall be summarily terminated
  • The Corporation reserves the right to prepare a panel for the posts advertised to fill up future vacancies arising after the publication of this advertisement
  • Any corrigendum/addendum/errata in respect of this advertisement shall be displayed only on ALIMCO's website i.e. www.alimco.in under the head "Recruitment". No further press advertisement will be issued
  • All important information regarding this recruitment will be available on the ALIMCO website www.alimco.in and candidates are advised to visit the website periodically to get updates

How to Apply

  • Candidates desirous of applying to any position must apply through online mode only
  • Candidates must create their profile first by clicking on the following link: https://erp.alimco.in/sap/bc/webdynpro/sap/zhrap_erecuritment#
  • The applicants can start applying from 31.01.2026 since 2:00 PM afternoon and last date for submission of the Online Application Form is 10.03.2026 by 05:00 PM

  • The profile can be completed using the above link and feeding all the data asked for and uploading all the documents relating to Age, Caste, Educational Qualification and Experience
  • Once the profile is created, the posts advertised by ALIMCO will appear in the candidate's login. Candidates may apply for one position at a time by clicking on the respective post
  • Candidates who desire to apply for more than one post must use separate forms for each application and also pay separate fee for each application
  • The Candidates should have a unique Mobile Number and valid e-mail ID for Registration
  • Candidates must possess a valid email ID which must be entered compulsorily in the online application form and cannot be changed once submitted
  • All correspondence with candidates will be conducted through email only. ALIMCO will not be responsible for any loss or non-receipt of emails due to an invalid or incorrect email ID provided by the candidate
  • For payment of the application fee, candidates are required to visit the ALIMCO website (www.alimco.in), click on the "Career" option, and then select "Pay Recruitment Fee"
  • They will be redirected to the SBI e-Collect page, where they must click on the "GOVT/PSU/COURTS" option and search for "ALIMCO"
  • After selecting "M/s ALIMCO," candidates should choose "Recruitment Fee" from the Payment Category drop-down menu, enter the required payment details, download the payment receipt (PDF), and upload the same in the application form
  • SC/ST/PwBD and departmental candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee
  • Before starting the registration process, keep the following ready: Photograph (*.jpg, *.bmp, Size up to 200 KB), Signature (*.jpg, *.bmp, Size up to 200 KB), DOB Certificate (*.jpg, *.pdf, Size up to 2 MB), Caste Certificate if applicable (*.pdf, Size up to 2 MB), Disability Certificate if applicable (*.pdf, Size up to 2 MB), Education Certificates (*.pdf, Size up to 1 MB), Experience-related Supporting documents (*.pdf, Size up to 1 MB), Fee Receipt of transaction file if applicable (*.pdf, .jpg, size up to 2 MB)
  • Once generated OTP will be sent to an e-mail ID provided by the applicant. After submission of OTP, the candidate can complete the registration process
  • Once the registration process is done, candidates can enter the Application Form by mentioning their USER ID (capital letter) and PASSWORD respectively
  • After login, a candidate needs to fill in their profile details like Personal Data, Educational Qualification, Work Experience, etc.
  • Before submitting the application form candidate needs to click on the save option. Upon clicking on the save option pop-up screen would open for further process of submission
  • After saving the application form candidate needs to upload a successful transaction receipt (if applicable)
  • At the last of the Application process candidates can choose the POST applied
  • After filling in all the above-required details, the candidate needs to click on the "submit your application" option
  • Once successfully submitted, candidates can save/print the application form for future reference
  • Once the profile is completed, the applicant should remember their username and password for future reference
  • Candidates are advised to submit their online recruitment applications well in advance
  • If any queries regarding submission of application form, candidate can reach on e-mail: [email protected] latest by 06.03.2026 till 05:00 PM
  • For detailed information regarding eligibility and other requirements, interested candidates may visit the ALIMCO website i.e. www.alimco.in
  • The Candidate shall keep in touch with the website for further information. No separate communication will be sent by the Corporation

    • SC / ST / ESM / OBC-NCL / PwBD: 40 marks out of 100
  • Computer Based Test will be conducted separately for each post.
  • Tie-Breaking Rule: In case of equal marks, tie will be resolved by: (i) Higher score in Section-A; then (ii) Date of Birth – older candidates preferred; then (iii) Alphabetical order of names.

Separate merit lists for each cadre will be prepared; Excavation Cadre merit panel will be prepared first, followed by E&M Cadre with remaining candidates.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Principal: Trained M.A./M.Sc. (Hindi/English/Science/Maths/Biology/Chemistry/Physics/Computer Science) from any recognized University; B.Ed with minimum 4 years teaching experience at Classes 9–12; or M.Ed with a recognized PG degree; or trained Science Diploma holder with 15–20 years of commendable service. Candidate must not be below 30 years of age.
  • PGT Hindi: M.A. in Hindi with Sanskrit from any recognized University, or Shastri from Government Sanskrit College, Varanasi / Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, Varanasi. Must be trained.
  • PGT English: Post-graduation (Master’s Degree) in English from any recognized State/Central University; or B.El.Ed Diploma; or B.Ed with Education Degree/Diploma. Must be trained. Preference to Education Graduates.
  • PGT Maths: M.A./M.Sc. in Maths or B.Sc. (Hons) with Maths; or B.Ed with three-year course with Maths. Must be trained.

  • PGT Chemistry: M.Sc. in Chemistry; or B.Sc. (Hons) in Chemistry with three-year course; or Post-Graduate (Biochemistry) from a recognized University; or Post-Graduate Diploma in Chemistry from a recognized University / Education Department, UP. Must be trained.
  • PGT Physics: M.Sc. in Physical Science; or Post-Graduate Diploma in Physical Science from the Education Department, UP. Must be trained.
  • Computer Science: M.Tech (Computer Science); or BE/B.Tech (Computer Science); or MCA from recognized University; or M.Sc./M.C.Sc. (Computer Science) from recognized University; or B Level from DOEACC/DIT; or Post-Graduate Diploma in Computer Science; or B.Sc. (Computer Component/Consulting/Science) from recognized University; or Post-Graduate with A-level DOEACC/DIT Diploma in Computer Science. Must be trained.
  • Lab Assistant: HSC (High School) level with Diploma in Laboratory Technology; or Diploma from a recognized Board in Lab-Science stream.

  • Full-Time Teacher – English: Post-Graduation (or Graduation with B.Ed) from a recognized University; and B.Ed/High Primary level training (not applicable for B.P.Ed/C.P.Ed/D.P.Ed).
  • Full-Time Teacher – Maths: Post-Graduation from a recognized University; and B.Ed/High Primary level training.
  • Full-Time Teacher – Science: Post-Graduation from a recognized University; and B.Ed/High Primary level training.
  • Caretaker: Post-Graduation with B.Ed.
  • Accountant: Graduation in Commerce with M.Com.; office work knowledge mandatory; Diploma in Computer Science from DOEACC/DIT or equivalent at “O” level.
  • Head Cook / Peon / Watchman / Assistant Cook: Class 8 Pass. Candidate must not suffer from physical disability or contagious disease.

Salary/Stipend

  • Principal: Rs. 30,000/- per month
  • PGT Hindi / PGT English / PGT Maths / PGT Life Science / PGT Chemistry / PGT Physics / Computer Science: Rs. 22,000/- per month
  • Lab Assistant: Rs. 7,147/- per month
  • Office Superintendent / Clerk: Rs. 12,430/- per month
  • Full-Time Teacher (English / Maths / Science): Rs. 25,410/- per month
  • Caretaker: Rs. 24,200/- per month
  • Accountant: Rs. 13,673/- per month
  • Head Cook: Rs. 9,006/- per month
  • Peon / Lab Assistant: Rs. 7,147/- per month
  • Watchman: Rs. 7,147/- per month
  • Assistant Cook: Rs. 6,433/- per month
  • Salary will be paid as per fixed honorarium (mandeya) on a new service contract basis.
  • Salary payment will be made only after verification of original academic certificates.

Age Limit 

  • Principal: Minimum age 30 years, Maximum age 45 years; with at least 4 years teaching experience in Classes 9–12.
  • All Other Posts: Minimum age 25 years, Maximum age 45 years (as on 01 April 2025).
  • Service in Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas: Maximum age up to 60 years.
  • Age will be calculated as on 01 April 2025 based on High School / Class 8 Certificate.
  • Age relaxation and reservation will be applicable as per State Government norms (OBC / SC / ST / EWS as applicable).
  • Candidates must submit proof of reservation category along with the application; failure to do so will result in denial of reservation benefits.

Application Fee

  • The application must be sent in an envelope with postal stamps of Rs. 45/- affixed (for Speed Post / Registered Post).
  • Applications sent via ordinary post or courier will be rejected.
  • Two self-attested photographs must be enclosed with the application.
  • All academic certificates, identity/proof documents, experience certificates, Aadhaar Card, training certificates, and photocopies of required documents must be enclosed.
  • A separate self-addressed envelope with Rs. 45/- postal stamp must be attached.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 10/02/2026
Age Calculated As On 01/04/2025
Last Date to Apply (Hard Copy via Speed Post / Registered Post) 06/03/2026 (by 5:00 PM)

Selection Process

  • Recruitment of teaching staff will be compiled at district level post-wise / subject-wise / category-wise; applications will be invited accordingly.
  • Separate merit lists will be prepared post-wise / subject-wise / category-wise for selection.
  • Merit weightage (Quality Marks) will be calculated as follows:
    • High School: Percentage of marks obtained × 10/100
    • Intermediate: Percentage of marks obtained × 10/100
    • Graduation: Percentage of marks obtained × 20/100
    • Post-Graduation: Percentage of marks obtained × 20/100
    • Training (B.Ed/M.Ed etc.): Percentage of marks in theory & practical × 30/100
  • If two or more candidates have equal merit points, the older candidate (higher age) will be placed higher in the merit list.
  • If merit and age are both equal, the candidate whose name appears earlier in English alphabetical order will be ranked higher.
  • Selection for Head Cook, Assistant Cook, Peon and Watchman will be based on interview.
  • Original documents/certificates of selected staff will be verified from the concerned Board/Institution at the time of appointment.
  • Original academic records will be preserved/safeguarded at the District Project Office. Salary will be paid only after document verification.

General Information / Instructions

  • Only female candidates will be selected for teaching/non-teaching vacancies in Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas. Male candidates must not apply.
  • The notification and application form can be downloaded from the NIC website of Kasganj district.
  • For further information, applicants may contact the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Kasganj on any working day.
  • The selected full-time staff (including Caretaker, Head Cook, Peon, Watchman and Assistant Cook) must reside within the school premises. Family members of permanent staff are not permitted to stay on the campus. All staff must arrange their own meals.
  • The number of vacancies may increase or decrease as per requirement. Selection is on a service contract basis for one academic session (maximum 11 months / 329 days); if performance is satisfactory, the contract may be extended for the next session.
  • On the envelope, the post name, subject, category and reservation category must be clearly mentioned in bold letters. If applying for more than one post, a separate application is required for each post.
  • Incomplete, unsigned, or applications without required attachments will be rejected.
  • The District Selection Committee reserves the right to cancel this advertisement; no appeal will be entertained thereafter. Typographical errors in the notification remain the responsibility of the issuing authority.
  • The Principal will not be appointed separately as a subject-specific teacher for the same subject; subject teaching will be carried out by the Principal herself.
  • Reservation benefits will be as per State Government norms. OBC / SC / ST / EWS certificates issued by a competent authority must be attached; otherwise reservation benefits will not be given.
  • Candidates with moral turpitude, character/criminal convictions, or declared bankrupt are not eligible.

How to Apply

  • Download the application form from the NIC website of Kasganj district.
  • Fill the application form clearly in the candidate's own handwriting (cutting and overwriting are not allowed).
  • Name and father’s name must be written as per High School / Class 8 certificate.
  • Attach two self-attested recent passport-size photographs.
  • Enclose self-attested photocopies of all academic mark sheets, certificates, proof documents, experience certificate, Aadhaar Card, training certificates, and any other required documents.
  • Mention the post name, subject, and reservation category on the envelope in bold letters.
  • Attach a separate self-addressed envelope with Rs. 45/- postal stamp affixed.
  • Send the completed application only via Speed Post or Registered Post to the following address:
    Office of District Basic Education Officer, Behind Vikas Bhavan, Prahladpur Soren Road, Kasganj – 207403
  • Last Date: Applications must reach by 06 March 2026 (5:00 PM).
  • Applications received via ordinary post or courier will be rejected.
  • Incomplete / unsigned / applications without attachments will be summarily rejected.

Vacancy Details

High Court of Allahabad has announced the recruitment of Special Judicial Magistrates for two districts in Uttar Pradesh. These positions are on a fixed honorarium basis with conveyance allowance. The recruitment is open for Government servants or former Government employees who possess legal qualifications or have extensive experience in legal affairs.

District Vacancy Position
Gonda 1 Special Judicial Magistrate
Jalaun (Orai) 1 Special Judicial Magistrate

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Status: Must be a Government servant (current or former) OR has held any post under the Government of India/State Government/Union Territory
  • Educational Qualification: Must possess:
    • Law degree (LL.B. from a recognized university), OR
    • Be well-experienced in relation to legal affairs to the satisfaction of the High Court
  • Professional Background: Experience in legal matters, judicial work, or administrative/legal roles under Government is an advantage

Term & Age

  • Term of Office: 4 years from the date of assumption of charge OR attaining the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier
  • Age Limit: No specific upper age limit mentioned, but term ends at age 70
  • Transferability: A candidate appointed for a specific district shall NOT be transferred to any other district under any circumstances

Previous SJM/SMM Experience

  • Ex-SJMs appointed by Government of Uttar Pradesh do NOT need to submit character roll entries
  • Ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment must enclose four best judgments delivered while holding the post of SJM/SMM

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Released 09.02.2026
Application Submission Last Date 13-04-2026
Selection Process Merit-based by High Court
Term of Office 4 Years or Age 70 years

Selection Process

  • Application Scrutiny: All applications are submitted to the respective District Judge who conducts preliminary scrutiny
  • District Judge Review: The District Judge reviews applications and forwards only those he finds fit for the SJM post to the High Court with his remarks
  • High Court Evaluation: The High Court evaluates forwarded applications based on qualifications, experience, and legal expertise
  • Merit-Based Selection: Selection is based on merit, qualifications, Government service record, and experience in legal matters
  • Final Appointment: Appointment is made by the High Court through formal order of the Court

Salary/Remuneration

  • Fixed Honorarium: ₹45,000/- per month (fixed, subject to correction and updation by High Court)
  • Conveyance Allowance: ₹5,000/- per month for official travel and conveyance
  • Total Monthly Remuneration: ₹50,000/- per month (base honorarium + conveyance)
  • Payment: Subject to correction and updation from time to time as per High Court guidelines

How to Apply

Application Preparation

  1. Download the Application Form from the official High Court notification PDF
  2. Fill all columns of the application form in block letters (all columns are compulsory)
  3. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph
  4. Provide complete and accurate information including:
    • Full name, father's name, date of birth
    • Current and permanent residential addresses with PIN codes
    • Email address and mobile number
    • Details of posts held under the Government (designation, pay scale, duration, retirement date)
    • Educational qualifications (High School, Intermediate, Graduation, LL.B., and any other qualifications)
    • Whether previously worked as SJM/SMM with year-wise details and annual confidential report percentages
  5. Mention whether any criminal case is pending or FIR lodged
  6. Sign the declaration that all information provided is correct

Required Documents (Self-Attested)

  • Photocopies of all relevant documents mentioned in the application
  • Character roll entries of the last 5 years of Government service (if applicable)
  • Law degree certificate and other educational qualification certificates
  • Copy of Gazette notification of Government service record
  • For ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment: Four best judgments delivered as SJM/SMM
  • Annual Confidential Reports (ACR) for the last 5 years (if available)
  • Self-attested photograph (4x6 cm)

Submission Mode

  1. Applicants must submit their applications OFFLINE directly to the respective District Judge of the district for which they are applying
  2. Do NOT send applications directly to the High Court — applications sent directly to High Court will be rejected
  3. Submit to the following District Judges based on your choice:
    • For Gonda: District Judge, Gonda District Court
    • For Jalaun: District Judge, Jalaun District Court
  4. Ensure all documents are complete and properly organized
  5. Keep a copy of submitted application for reference

Eligibility Criteria for UPSSSC Pharmacist 2026

1. Educational Qualification

As per Uttar Pradesh Bheshajik Seva Niyamavali, 1980 (Part-4, Rule-8), candidates must possess a Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognised institution and must also be registered with the State Pharmacy Council, Uttar Pradesh to apply for UPSSSC Pharmacist posts.

2. Preferred Qualification (Adhimani Arhata)

As per Rule-9 of Uttar Pradesh Bheshajik Seva Niyamavali, 1980, preference will be given to candidates who have either served in the Provincial Army for a minimum period of two years, or have obtained the 'B' certificate of the National Cadet Corps (NCC).

3. Age Limit

The age limit for UPSSSC Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years
  • Age Relaxation: As per UP Government rules — SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will get relaxation as notified from time to time.
  • For UP State Government Employees: 5 years relaxation in upper age limit as per relevant government order.
  • Age Calculation Date: 1st January of the year of recruitment (or 1st July if post is advertised between 1st July to 31st December).

4. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens as specified in the official notification.

5. PET Eligibility Condition

Only those candidates who have appeared in the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET-2025) and have been issued a score card by UPSSSC are eligible to apply for this Main Examination. Candidates who scored zero or negative marks in PET-2025 will not be shortlisted.

Selection Process for UPSSSC Pharmacist 2026

The selection for UPSSSC Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following process:

  • Shortlisting for Main Examination: Based on normalised scores of PET-2025. Candidates will be shortlisted at 15 times the number of vacancies (up to the final cut-off mark at 2 decimal places).
  • Main Written Examination (Likhit Pariksha): One objective-type question paper with 100 questions, total 100 marks, duration 2 hours (120 minutes). Negative marking of 25% (i.e., ¼ mark) for each wrong answer.
  • Document Verification: For selected candidates after the written exam.
